rows.title: Associate Digital Workplace Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Working at Caplugs, you’ll find a team-oriented environment working to deliver best-in-class products and service to more than 24,000 customers around the world. Our customers trust us with their product production needs day after day, and that trust starts with our most critical asset – our people. We work to identify and develop talent, continuously focusing on innovation, learning and improvement to deliver on our promise to be the product protection partner our customers need to solve their challenges. Are you ready to be a part of our team?
SUMMARY: The Digital Workplace Analyst, Associate supports Protective Industries' multi-year modernization of how employees create, manage, share, and access information. The role is an early career opportunity focused on Microsoft 365 adoption, content migration coordination, employee training, documentation, user experience, and project support.Working under the Infrastructure & Digital Workplace Manager, the analyst will collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, HR, ERP, Operations, business stakeholders, and external partners. The role will play a key part in advancing Protective Industries' Digital Workplace strategy by coordinating content modernization initiatives, supporting business stakeholders, driving adoption of Microsoft 365 capabilities, and helping employees effectively leverage modern collaboration, communication, and productivity tools across the enterprise.
Role focus: coordinate, document, train, support adoption, monitor the Microsoft roadmap, and connect business needs with the appropriate internal or external expertise.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Other duties may be assigned.1. Enterprise Content Migration and Governance SupportSupport development and maintenance of a multi-year roadmap for moving legacy file-share content into Microsoft 365, including SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams. Coordinate migration waves by function, beginning with intellectual property and confidential content, followed by other prioritized business areas.Maintain inventories, schedules, action logs, readiness checklists, risks, decisions, and status reporting for each migration wave. Partner with content owners to identify obsolete, duplicate, sensitive, or business-critical information before migration.Coordinate user communications, department readiness, user acceptance testing, go-live activities, and post-migration adoption support. Help apply established standards for site structure, permissions, retention, sensitivity, naming, and content ownership. Escalate design or policy decisions to the appropriate owner.Document lessons learned and maintain a repeatable migration playbook for future departments and locations.
2. HRIS Program and Employee Content Support Support HR and ERP project migration activities related to moving employee content and processes from NAV2018 to the future HRIS platform.Assist with employee document inventories, content cleanup, organization, mapping, and migration readiness. Coordinate training, communications, user acceptance testing, issue tracking, and employee adoption activities.Help ensure HR content is handled according to approved security, privacy, retention, and access requirements. Serve as a liaison among IT, project teams, and implementation partners for assigned work and follow-up actions.
3. Operations, Plant, and Office Content DistributionSupport requirements gathering and evaluation of a scalable platform for plant, frontline, office, and mobile employee communications. Coordinate demonstrations, pilots, user feedback, testing, documentation, and rollout readiness.Partner with Operations, HR, Safety, Communications, and site leadership to understand audience and content-delivery needs. Support implementation, training, and adoption after platform selection.Maintain content standards, operating procedures, and support documentation as the capability matures.
4. Microsoft 365 Adoption, Training, and Roadmap Support Act as an internal champion for Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Viva, Forms, Loop, Copilot, and other approved Microsoft 365 productivity capabilities.Monitor the Microsoft 365 roadmap, summarize relevant changes, coordinate testing, and help organize pilot programs. Identify and/or create practical training materials, quick-reference guides, FAQs, knowledge articles, short videos, and launch communications.Deliver user training, office hours, workshops, and role-based adoption sessions using a structured change and adoption approach. Gather user feedback and adoption data, identify recurring barriers, and recommend improvements to tools, guidance, or support.Provide limited concierge support during launches and major deployments, while transitioning repeatable support needs to the help desk or managed service provider. Maintain the Digital Workplace backlog and support quarterly planning and prioritization with the manager and stakeholders.
SCOPE AND ROLE BOUNDARIES: This position is an important internal contributor, but it is not a help desk, senior engineering, architecture, or program management role. Responsibilities will be shared across the operating model below.Coordinates work, readiness, training, documentation, adoption, testing, and follow-up. Other Teams and Partners: Infrastructure owns core platform administration and technical operations.Applies approved standards and escalates policy, architecture, and security decisions. Other Teams and Partners: Security and governance owners define controls, policies, classification, DLP, and risk decisions.Provides short-term concierge support during launches. Other Teams and Partners: Help desk and managed services provide scalable, ongoing end-user support.Maintains project artifacts, backlogs, status, user feedback, and playbooks. Other Teams and Partners: Consulting and implementation partners perform complex architecture, migration tooling, engineering, and specialized delivery.Supports HRIS and content-distribution initiatives as an IT coordinator and adoption resource. Other Teams and Partners: Business owners make process, priority, content ownership, and vendor selection decisions.
QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, Communications, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.One to three years of experience in information technology, business systems, collaboration tools, project coordination, user support, training, or a related area.Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Office applications. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technology in clear, practical terms.Strong organization, follow-through, documentation, and attention to detail. Customer-service mindset and comfort working directly with employees across functions, levels, locations, and technical abilities.Ability to manage multiple assignments, maintain action logs, and escalate issues appropriately. Interest in learning Microsoft platforms, information governance, change management, and digital workplace practices. Preferred QualificationsExperience supporting SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 administration, or content migration activities. Experience creating or delivering training, knowledge articles, videos, job aids, or adoption communications.Exposure to HRIS, ERP, intranet, employee communication, or digital signage initiatives. Experience working with vendors, consultants, or managed service providers.Experience in manufacturing, a multi-site organization, or a global business environment. Microsoft Fundamentals or role-based certifications, or a demonstrated plan to pursue relevant certifications.CORE COMPETENCIES Learning Agility: Quickly learns new Microsoft 365 capabilities, business processes, and support models. User Empathy: Understands employee needs and translates technical change into practical guidance. Execution Discipline: Keeps plans, actions, issues, documentation, and communications current. Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across IT, HR, Operations, Security, and third parties. Judgment: Works independently within defined standards and knows when to escalate. Change Orientation: Helps users move from familiar legacy practices to governed, modern ways of working.MEASURES OF SUCCESSMigration waves are organized, documented, and delivered with clear business readiness and user support. Training, communications, and adoption activities are available for major Digital Workplace releases.HRIS-related employee content activities meet agreed project milestones and quality expectations. Digital Workplace documentation, knowledge articles, playbooks, and backlogs remain current and usable.User feedback and recurring support themes are captured and converted into practical improvements. Infrastructure and project teams spend less time on routine Microsoft 365 guidance and coordination.New Microsoft 365 capabilities are regularly reviewed, tested, and advanced when they provide clear business value.CAREER DEVELOPMENT: This role is designed as an early-career growth opportunity. With demonstrated performance and continued development, the employee may progress toward roles such as Microsoft 365 Administrator, Business Systems Analyst, Digital Workplace Product Owner, Collaboration Analyst, or Digital Workplace Manager.WORKING CONDITIONS AND TRAVEL Western New York candidates are preferred. Remote candidates may be considered based on qualifications and business needs. Occasional travel to company offices or manufacturing locations may be required for discovery, training, pilots, or deployments. Work may occasionally be scheduled outside standard business hours to support deployments or global teams.EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY: Protective Industries is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to any status protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.NOTE: This job description summarizes the primary duties of the role and is not intended to be an exhaustive list.

Job Description

Credit & Fraud Risk (CFR) manages the risk strategies across all markets and portfolios to minimize the company’s credit and fraud losses while promoting business growth and delivering superior customer service.

The objective of the CFR Control Management Governance team is to establish the Operational Risk and Controls strategy for CFR, set up a foundational governance structure that ensures operational risks are identified, assessed, and managed in compliance with enterprise Operational Risk Management programs and reporting.

CFR is looking for a Sr. Analyst of Governance focused on ensuring control management is embedded in the day-to-day operations of our organization. It will involve extensive collaboration with multiple partners across numerous business units, functional areas, and geographies.

Responsibilities

The Senior. Analyst, CFR Governance will:

 Support certain execution plans for operational risk management within the business unit (BU), including BU specific guidelines, project plans, etc.  Track specific issues with KRI limits and risk appetite for CFR to ensure operational risks are managed within agreed thresholds  Assist in the implementation of portions of the operational risk framework to enable effective risk management and decision making in the BU  Help in the development of BU-specific procedures and additional standards (i.e., escalation protocols), related to the execution of the Operational Risk Management programs  Facilitate the understanding and use of the risk governance framework basics across BUs through regular communication  Aggregate specific reporting areas, approvals/exceptions and support "change-the-function" activities for the BU  Administer implementation of specific training initiatives and clear career progression plans that align with Operational Risk Management  Review processes to ensure and monitor the integration of regulatory changes & updates into the Operational Risk framework and training materials  Support sharing insights, better practices, themes, etc. across the enterprise 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

 2+ Years experience in operational risk management (e.g., within Risk and/or Internal Audit function) Understanding of critical operational risk management lifecycle activities  Project management, communication, and interpersonal skills  Experience in process governance, with an understanding of processes that align with policies, regulatory frameworks, and/or operational standards  Sound analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to analyze data, identify trends, and evaluate risk scenarios effectively 

Preferred Qualifications

 Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Business, Risk Mgmt., or related field; advanced degrees (e.g., MBA, MSc) or certifications are advantageous  Experience in at least one of the following: Translating operational risk strategy and appetite into execution guidelines  Tracking and identifying issues with Key Risk Indicator (KRI) limits and risk appetite to ensure operational risks are managed within agreed thresholds  Facilitating the implementation of the operational risk governance frameworks  Developing, communicating and ensuring understanding and adherence to operational risk procedures and standards  Supporting the operational risk exam management processes

Job Description

Goldman Sachs Marketing

Led by the firm’s first Chief Marketing Officer, the marketing function at Goldman Sachs is backed by momentum and a broad imperative to unify the discipline, helping to codify a business-critical function seen as core to the firm’s future growth. As such, GS is focused on building out a data-and-technology enabled team of growth marketers, delivering value for the brand and the business. The organization will consist of a number of key COE roles in areas such as Brand, Media, and Marketing Strategy, as well as marketing leads for each of our revenue divisions. Together, this team will collaborate to build a unified, scalable, and consistent approach to marketing the brand and its offerings. Our mission is to be a demonstrable force multiplier for the businesses we serve.

Within the Global Marketing function but aligned to the Global Banking and Markets division, sits the Transaction Banking marketing team, responsible for end-to-end marketing strategies and programs for the entirety of the division. Working across the core elements of the franchise -- the team leads messaging strategy, content creation, client engagement strategy, digital marketing, and marketing analytics.

TRANSACTION BANKING (TxB)

We aim to build a modern and digital-first transaction banking solution to serve our clients. Our business combines the strength, heritage, and expertise of a 150-year-old firm with the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of a tech start-up. Our goal is to provide a best-in-class digital product that helps clients to succeed by giving them a holistic view of their business. Through the use of modern technology built on the cloud, we are the alternative to legacy platforms. We’re a team of diverse experts helping our clients to build the future of their Treasury.

Job Summary And Responsibilities

We are looking for an intellectually ambitious, driven, entrepreneurial Associate to support the Transaction Banking marketing team. They will partner across the divisional marketing team, product and coverage teams to develop and execute content creation, digital marketing, conferences and events, paid media, social media, analytics, and design to support the commercial objectives of the business.

Responsibilities

This person will also help develop content ideas and distribution strategies to drive engagement with clients and prospective clients. This person will also have a hand in measurement and analytics as we translate our team’s work into commercial impact for key stakeholders. The position also involves project management, budget management, production oversight, regulatory compliance, stakeholder management. Responsibilities include:

Work closely with product and coverage teams to develop and execute bespoke marketing content around TxB products Lead and project manage external agencies for the end-to-end creation, design, and amplification of key marketing assets. Create and author briefs, storyboards, scripts, Q&As, ensuring they are clear and actionable.Measure marketing impact through the use of data analytics tools and feedback from senior leadershipCreate and oversee channel plans and creative elements, authoring social posts and emails, developing creative assets, and creating mock-ups.Support comprehensive planning and execution of industry conference participation. Track client meetings, create internal briefing documents, develop panel proposals, and lead speaker preparation.Support planning and execution of in-person and virtual client events, including agenda development, collateral creation, and speaker preparation. Manage a dedicated budget line item for content marketing initiatives, ensuring resources are allocated efficiently and effectively.Manage approvals across legal and compliance, leadership, stakeholders, and business lines, where applicable, ensuring all content meets regulatory, compliance, and brand standards. Understand Transaction Banking Products (Liquidity, Payments, FX, Channels) and clients (corporate, FIs, etc.)

Qualifications

3-5 years experience in marketing or communicationsStrong project management skills with the ability to prioritize a high volume of tasks, manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders simultaneously, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment while maintaining extremely high standards.Generalist marketing skills including familiarity with marketing strategy, target audience definitions, creative development, content creation.Thrives in fast-paced environment with the ability to think clearly under pressure, and handle simultaneous projects and deadlinesLiaise with and build strong relationships with cross-functional teams and leaders.Collaborative, team player attitude with the ability to navigate and influence the organizationExcellent attention to detail and ability to act on detailed feedbackExcellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, time management and planning skillsExperience with Salesforce, Adobe Campaign, Figma, Sprinklr, and other B2B marketing tools Go getter with a “can do” attitude, the perfect candidate for this role should be ready to assist with any and all tasksCreative problem solverSuccess in navigating corporate environments or startupsComfortable working autonomously Experience working in financial services is a plus

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers .

We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https:// www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

© The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2026. All rights reserved.

Goldman Sachs is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veterans status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Salary Range

The expected base salary for this New York, New York, United States-based position is $100000-$160000. In addition, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus if you are an active employee as of fiscal year-end.

Benefits

Goldman Sachs is committed to providing our people with valuable and competitive benefits and wellness offerings, as it is a core part of providing a strong overall employee experience. A summary of these offerings, which are generally available to active, non-temporary, full-time and part-time US employees who work at least 20 hours per week, can be found here .

rows.descriptionText:
The New York City Department of Transportation (DOT) provides for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and maintains and enhances the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.

This candidate will serve as a Data Scientist in NYC DOT’s Bike Share & Shared Mobility unit, which is responsible for planning and oversight of the Citi Bike program and other shared micro mobility services in New York City. Citi Bike is a public transportation service and a public-private partnership that is among the largest and most successful bike share systems in the world. The program is in the midst of a five-year expansion that will ultimately double the size of its previous service area and put more than 40,000 bicycles within a five-minute walk of half of NYC residents. Other shared micro-mobility services in NYC include dockless e-scooter and e-moped shares.

We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our team and play a pivotal role in shaping how we understand, monitor, and optimize our shared mobility systems. This individual will combine data analytics, advanced visualization, and strategic storytelling to translate complex data from Citi Bike and Shared E-Scooter programs into actionable insights that inform planning and day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of analytics and communication - able to uncover patterns, craft compelling narratives, and partner with internal team members at all levels to drive informed decision-making.

Reporting to the Director of Data Science, the Data Scientist will be responsible for, but not limited to:

Data Analytics & Research

 Conduct research and analysis on bike share and shared mobility to inform current and future planning Prepare reports and briefing materials based on the databases that underlie the bike share and shared mobility systems Monitor vendor compliance with governmental regulations, DOT policies, and contract terms Develop predictive models to answer complex and nuanced questions about the programs and anticipate future needs and behavior of the systems Respond quickly and accurately to ad hoc data requests for internal and external stakeholders

Visualization & Storytelling

 Develop and maintain dashboards to deliver insights to internal team members using software such as Power BITranslate data into stories that resonate with senior staff, managers, and staff, highlighting both the "what" and the "why"

Strategic Thinking & Partnership

 Collaborate with leadership, Operations, Planning, and Policy teams to align analytics and research agendas with organizational priorities Offer evidence-based recommendations to support system planning, managing existing service areas, and shaping future policy decisions Act as a trusted advisor and build strong relationships with the internal team members.

Data Management

 Monitor data quality, identify issues, and maintain data integrity. Document data management procedures (e.g., data dictionaries, business rules) Plan, design, maintain, and support unit internal databases

CITY RESEARCH SCIENTIST - 21744

Minimum Qualifications

 For Assignment Level I (only physical, biological and environmental sciences and public health) A master's degree from an accredited college or university with a specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological or environmental science or in public health.

To be appointed to Assignment Level II and above, candidates must have:

 A doctorate degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and one year of full-time experience in a responsible supervisory, administrative or research capacity in the appropriate field of specialization; or A master's degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and three years of responsible full-time research experience in the appropriate field of specialization; or Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least a master's degree in an appropriate field of specialization and at least two years of experience described in "2" above. Two years as a City Research Scientist Level I can be substituted for the experience required in "1" and "2" above.

Note

Probationary Period

Appointments to this position are subject to a minimum probationary period of one year.

Preferred Skills

Preferred Skills - Mastery with spreadsheets and at least one coding language (Python, R, etc.) for data manipulation - Experience in querying, cleaning, and maintaining large relational databases using SQL - Experience with data visualization software such as Power BI and/or Tableau - Strong familiarity with providing statistical support by participating in the development of statistical methodology, study design, and data analysis of analytical projects - Mastery with presentation slides, data visualization software, maps, and memos. This includes leveraging visualization tools to present information in a way that drives fact-based decision making by developing intuitive static and interactive data graphics - Ability to relate complex trends in the data to larger policy issues, to work with the operations and planning team to tailor data analysis and products to their needs -Excellent interpersonal, analytical, research, presentation, written, and oral communication skills -Willingness to be flexible and work as part of a team -Experience or interest in transportation planning, logistics, bike share, micro mobility, cycling, and working with or in the public sector.

Public Service Loan Forgiveness

As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/.

New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview.

rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Perchwell is the modern real estate listings platform built for agents to search smarter, collaborate better, and close deals faster. We are building the future of residential real estateʼs critical listings infrastructure: a platform where market research and client collaboration converge. Our modern architecture enables continuous innovation at a pace legacy systems cannot match, with AI-powered features and mobile-first capabilities designed for how agents actually work. As consumer expectations and technology evolve, Perchwell remains focused on our core vision: empowering real estate professionals with the most intelligent, data-driven, and connected platform in the industry.

Backed by leading venture capital firms including Lux Capital and Founders Fund, along with strategic partnerships with some of the country's top Multiple Listing Services (MLSs), Perchwell represents the first major new platform to enter the listings technology market in decades. This unique combination of institutional investment and deep industry alignment provides both the resources and market validation needed to transform the multi-trillion dollar residential real estate industry.

About This Role

Perchwell is expanding rapidly across the US, and every new MLS client brings a data source we haven't worked with before. Our Data Analytics Engineering team owns what happens next: understanding what is actually in that data, transforming it into our warehouse, and building the intelligence layer that sits on top of it. This summer, you'll work on that alongside our analytics engineers and data engineers, supporting both the MLS customers we serve today and the ones we're onboarding next.

What We’re Looking For

Rising seniors enrolled in a CS, data science, statistics, or other STEM degree program who are looking to intern at a fast paced SaaS company this summer. Passionate problem solvers who thrive in fast moving environments. Strong communicators and team players who can work cross functionally. Careful thinkers who chase down a number that looks wrong instead of passing it along. Eager learners who want to gain real world analytics engineering experience. 

What You’ll Do

Understand New Data: Profile the data we are ingesting for new clients and partner with members of the broader engineering org to identify the most effective patterns for onboarding them into our standard reporting product. Build and Ship: Extend the dbt models that transform raw MLS data into our warehouse, adding the tests and documentation the rest of the team depends on. Build Intelligence: Strengthen the layer that sits on top of the warehouse, including metric definitions, semantic models, and the dashboards internal teams and customers rely on. Own a Project: Take ownership of a summer project, making key modeling, tooling, and implementation decisions. Profiling and mapping a new non MLS data source is one strong candidate. Collaborate and Learn: Partner with analytics engineers, data engineers, product managers, and customer facing teams to turn open questions into answers people can act on. Deliver Impact: Work on scalable solutions from broadly defined problems and see your work in production. 

Why This Internship? 

Dedicated Mentor: You'll work 1:1 with an experienced analytics engineer who will provide mentorship and support your growth. Real Ownership: Over 10 weeks, early June to mid August, you will choose and lead your own project, making key decisions along the way. Fully In Person Experience: This is a full time, in-office internship based at our beautiful New York City HQ in Soho. You'll work on site five days a week and collaborate closely with our team, gaining hands-on experience in a fast paced, learning oriented environment. Showcase Your Work: At the end of the summer, present your project to our executive and data teams. Work on Real Data: Beyond your project, you'll contribute to models, tests, and dashboards running in production against live customer data. NYC Perks and Fun: From team dinners to museum trips, immerse yourself in the greatest city in the world while working with an awesome team. 

Required For The Role

Working familiarity with RDBMS storage systems and SQL, including joins, aggregations, and CTEs. You don't need window functions yet, but you should want to learn them. Curiosity about where data comes from and what it represents, not just how to query it. Attention to detail and an instinct for when something doesn't add up. Strong communication and problem solving abilities. Excitement to learn, grow, and build. 

Bonus Points for the Following

Coursework, projects, or prior internship experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery. Exposure to dbt or another transformation framework. An understanding of Python for working with data, such as pandas in coursework or personal projects. Familiarity with Git and version controlled workflows. Experience with a BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, Mode, or Metabase. Any project, academic or personal, where you took messy source data and made it usable. Demonstrated leadership skills developed during your college experience. 

Internship Information

Internship Dates: June 7 - August 13, 2027

Application Deadline: Applications for this internship close on October 18, 2026, at 11 PM ET. Be sure to apply by the deadline to be considered! We will be reviewing all applications, so please take the time to submit a thoughtful application.

Offers: Internship offers will be extended by November 25, 2026.

Excited to launch your career with a tech startup in NYC? Apply now and build something meaningful with us in Summer 2027!

The AI Business Enablement Analyst supports the adoption and effective use of generative AI across the Investment Bank and Capital Markets & Advisory functions by designing, building, and improving AI-powered solutions across banker workflows through skills and prompts and emerging agent-based tools. Credit & Fraud Risk (CFR) manages the risk strategies across all markets and portfolios to minimize the company’s credit and fraud losses while promoting business growth and delivering superior customer service.

The objective of the CFR Control Management Governance team is to establish the Operational Risk and Controls strategy for CFR, set up a foundational governance structure that ensures operational risks are identified, assessed, and managed in compliance with enterprise Operational Risk Management programs and reporting.

CFR is looking for an Analyst of Governance focused on ensuring control management is embedded in the day-to-day operations of our organization. It will involve extensive collaboration with multiple partners across numerous business units, functional areas, and geographies.

Responsibilities

Assists in specific areas of execution plans for operational risk management within the business unit (BU), including BU specific guidelines, project plans, etc.Track certain issues with KRI limits and risk appetite for CFR to ensure operational risks are managed within agreed thresholdsSupport the implementation of parts of the operational risk framework to enable effective risk management and decision making in the BUAssists in the development of portions of BU-specific procedures and additional standards (i.e., escalation protocols), related to the execution of the Operational Risk Management programsHelp facilitate the understanding and use of the risk governance framework basics across BUs through regular communicationAssist to aggregate basic level reporting, approvals/exceptions and support "change-the-function" activities for the BUProvide administrative support of specific training initiatives and clear career progression plans that align with Operational Risk ManagementFollow processes to ensure and monitor the integration of regulatory changes & updates into the Operational Risk framework and training materialsSupport sharing insights, better practices, themes, etc. across the enterprise

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

1-2 Years experience in operational risk management (e.g., within Risk and/or Internal Audit function) Understanding of critical operational risk management lifecycle activitiesProject management, communication, and interpersonal skillsExperience in process governance, with an understanding of processes that align with policies, regulatory frameworks, and/or operational standardsAnalytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to analyze data, identify trends, and evaluate risk scenarios effectively

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Business, Risk Mgmt., or related field; advanced degrees (e.g., MBA, MSc) or certifications are advantageousExperience in at least one of the following:Translating operational risk strategy and appetite into execution guidelinesTracking and identifying issues with Key Risk Indicator (KRI) limits and risk appetite to ensure operational risks are managed within agreed thresholdsProvide administrative support of implementing the operational risk governance frameworksSupporting of creating, communicating and ensuring understanding and adherence to operational risk procedures and standardsAssisting the operational risk exam management processes

rows.title: Associate Digital Workplace Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Working at Caplugs, you’ll find a team-oriented environment working to deliver best-in-class products and service to more than 24,000 customers around the world. Our customers trust us with their product production needs day after day, and that trust starts with our most critical asset – our people. We work to identify and develop talent, continuously focusing on innovation, learning and improvement to deliver on our promise to be the product protection partner our customers need to solve their challenges. Are you ready to be a part of our team?
SUMMARY: The Digital Workplace Analyst, Associate supports Protective Industries' multi-year modernization of how employees create, manage, share, and access information. The role is an early career opportunity focused on Microsoft 365 adoption, content migration coordination, employee training, documentation, user experience, and project support.Working under the Infrastructure & Digital Workplace Manager, the analyst will collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, HR, ERP, Operations, business stakeholders, and external partners. The role will play a key part in advancing Protective Industries' Digital Workplace strategy by coordinating content modernization initiatives, supporting business stakeholders, driving adoption of Microsoft 365 capabilities, and helping employees effectively leverage modern collaboration, communication, and productivity tools across the enterprise.
Role focus: coordinate, document, train, support adoption, monitor the Microsoft roadmap, and connect business needs with the appropriate internal or external expertise.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Other duties may be assigned.1. Enterprise Content Migration and Governance SupportSupport development and maintenance of a multi-year roadmap for moving legacy file-share content into Microsoft 365, including SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams. Coordinate migration waves by function, beginning with intellectual property and confidential content, followed by other prioritized business areas.Maintain inventories, schedules, action logs, readiness checklists, risks, decisions, and status reporting for each migration wave. Partner with content owners to identify obsolete, duplicate, sensitive, or business-critical information before migration.Coordinate user communications, department readiness, user acceptance testing, go-live activities, and post-migration adoption support. Help apply established standards for site structure, permissions, retention, sensitivity, naming, and content ownership. Escalate design or policy decisions to the appropriate owner.Document lessons learned and maintain a repeatable migration playbook for future departments and locations.
2. HRIS Program and Employee Content Support Support HR and ERP project migration activities related to moving employee content and processes from NAV2018 to the future HRIS platform.Assist with employee document inventories, content cleanup, organization, mapping, and migration readiness. Coordinate training, communications, user acceptance testing, issue tracking, and employee adoption activities.Help ensure HR content is handled according to approved security, privacy, retention, and access requirements. Serve as a liaison among IT, project teams, and implementation partners for assigned work and follow-up actions.
3. Operations, Plant, and Office Content DistributionSupport requirements gathering and evaluation of a scalable platform for plant, frontline, office, and mobile employee communications. Coordinate demonstrations, pilots, user feedback, testing, documentation, and rollout readiness.Partner with Operations, HR, Safety, Communications, and site leadership to understand audience and content-delivery needs. Support implementation, training, and adoption after platform selection.Maintain content standards, operating procedures, and support documentation as the capability matures.
4. Microsoft 365 Adoption, Training, and Roadmap Support Act as an internal champion for Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Viva, Forms, Loop, Copilot, and other approved Microsoft 365 productivity capabilities.Monitor the Microsoft 365 roadmap, summarize relevant changes, coordinate testing, and help organize pilot programs. Identify and/or create practical training materials, quick-reference guides, FAQs, knowledge articles, short videos, and launch communications.Deliver user training, office hours, workshops, and role-based adoption sessions using a structured change and adoption approach. Gather user feedback and adoption data, identify recurring barriers, and recommend improvements to tools, guidance, or support.Provide limited concierge support during launches and major deployments, while transitioning repeatable support needs to the help desk or managed service provider. Maintain the Digital Workplace backlog and support quarterly planning and prioritization with the manager and stakeholders.
SCOPE AND ROLE BOUNDARIES: This position is an important internal contributor, but it is not a help desk, senior engineering, architecture, or program management role. Responsibilities will be shared across the operating model below.Coordinates work, readiness, training, documentation, adoption, testing, and follow-up. Other Teams and Partners: Infrastructure owns core platform administration and technical operations.Applies approved standards and escalates policy, architecture, and security decisions. Other Teams and Partners: Security and governance owners define controls, policies, classification, DLP, and risk decisions.Provides short-term concierge support during launches. Other Teams and Partners: Help desk and managed services provide scalable, ongoing end-user support.Maintains project artifacts, backlogs, status, user feedback, and playbooks. Other Teams and Partners: Consulting and implementation partners perform complex architecture, migration tooling, engineering, and specialized delivery.Supports HRIS and content-distribution initiatives as an IT coordinator and adoption resource. Other Teams and Partners: Business owners make process, priority, content ownership, and vendor selection decisions.
QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business, Communications, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.One to three years of experience in information technology, business systems, collaboration tools, project coordination, user support, training, or a related area.Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Office applications. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technology in clear, practical terms.Strong organization, follow-through, documentation, and attention to detail. Customer-service mindset and comfort working directly with employees across functions, levels, locations, and technical abilities.Ability to manage multiple assignments, maintain action logs, and escalate issues appropriately. Interest in learning Microsoft platforms, information governance, change management, and digital workplace practices. Preferred QualificationsExperience supporting SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 administration, or content migration activities. Experience creating or delivering training, knowledge articles, videos, job aids, or adoption communications.Exposure to HRIS, ERP, intranet, employee communication, or digital signage initiatives. Experience working with vendors, consultants, or managed service providers.Experience in manufacturing, a multi-site organization, or a global business environment. Microsoft Fundamentals or role-based certifications, or a demonstrated plan to pursue relevant certifications.CORE COMPETENCIES Learning Agility: Quickly learns new Microsoft 365 capabilities, business processes, and support models. User Empathy: Understands employee needs and translates technical change into practical guidance. Execution Discipline: Keeps plans, actions, issues, documentation, and communications current. Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across IT, HR, Operations, Security, and third parties. Judgment: Works independently within defined standards and knows when to escalate. Change Orientation: Helps users move from familiar legacy practices to governed, modern ways of working.MEASURES OF SUCCESSMigration waves are organized, documented, and delivered with clear business readiness and user support. Training, communications, and adoption activities are available for major Digital Workplace releases.HRIS-related employee content activities meet agreed project milestones and quality expectations. Digital Workplace documentation, knowledge articles, playbooks, and backlogs remain current and usable.User feedback and recurring support themes are captured and converted into practical improvements. Infrastructure and project teams spend less time on routine Microsoft 365 guidance and coordination.New Microsoft 365 capabilities are regularly reviewed, tested, and advanced when they provide clear business value.CAREER DEVELOPMENT: This role is designed as an early-career growth opportunity. With demonstrated performance and continued development, the employee may progress toward roles such as Microsoft 365 Administrator, Business Systems Analyst, Digital Workplace Product Owner, Collaboration Analyst, or Digital Workplace Manager.WORKING CONDITIONS AND TRAVEL Western New York candidates are preferred. Remote candidates may be considered based on qualifications and business needs. Occasional travel to company offices or manufacturing locations may be required for discovery, training, pilots, or deployments. Work may occasionally be scheduled outside standard business hours to support deployments or global teams.EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY: Protective Industries is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to any status protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.NOTE: This job description summarizes the primary duties of the role and is not intended to be an exhaustive list.

Reporting to the Product Business Architect, this role supports the evolution of the Global Dollar Card (GDC) product ecosystem through data-driven analysis, platform enablement, operational support, and cross-functional collaboration. Responsibilities

Source, analyze, and validate data from multiple enterprise systems to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights that support product initiatives, strategic projects, regulatory activities, and ongoing BAU needs. rows.title: Product Marketing Manager, Platform

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Alchemy

Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences.

Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com.

About The Role

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Platform to launch targeted campaigns across Alchemy's full platform, from product launches to new vertical and segment pushes, and to own the always-on content that fills the gaps in between. This is a high-ownership, high-influence seat with a long runway: you'll start as an executional hire, but there's a real path to Product Marketing Lead and to building a team under you if that's the direction you want to grow.

Alchemy isn't just infrastructure, it's a full platform: building blocks for reads, writes, launching custom chains, and more, spanning verticals from crypto-native builders to traditional finance moving assets onchain. Every campaign we run, whether it's a product launch, a new vertical push, or a piece of evergreen content, needs to tie back to one thing: Alchemy as the platform builders trust to build the future on. You'll own that positioning day to day, from the company-level narrative down to how a single launch is framed, working closely with Lisa (Product Marketing) especially early on as you build that domain authority.

You'll run point end to end: strategy, tactics, project management, measurement, and reporting, on everything from major campaigns to the product launches, newsletter beats, and social content that run continuously. You can and should delegate execution (design, technical content with DevRel, and more), but you own the outcome. When there's no active campaign, you're not idle: you own a pillar of Alchemy's always-on content, filling the gap with mid- and bottom-funnel work that drives activation and cross-sell across our existing platform.

What You’ll Do

Launch targeted campaigns across product launches and new vertical/segment pushes, owning the strategy, the tactics, and the project management from kickoff to report-out.Own and evolve Alchemy's platform positioning: the throughline that connects every campaign back to Alchemy as a frontier leader built for reliability and performance, backed by real customer stories.Own a pillar of Alchemy's always-on content cadence, mid- and bottom-funnel work, product launch beats, and activation/cross-sell content, whenever there isn't an active campaign in market.Go deep on individual product areas and wide across the full platform, building the kind of product and audience understanding that lets you spot the next campaign or market opportunity before anyone asks for it.Generate and pitch ideas for breaking into new markets and verticals, backed by a real read on the audience and the competitive landscape.Partner with DevRel to produce the technical content (docs-adjacent explainers, videos, tutorials) that supports a campaign or fills a content gap.Bring creative, visual thinking to launches that could otherwise be a dry API announcement, pushing for the campaign concept, not just the campaign checklist.Delegate execution to design, agencies, and other specialists as needed, while remaining accountable for the outcome, the timeline, and the numbers.Build stakeholder trust across Product, Engineering, and DevRel, so that partner teams want to work with you again.

What We’re Looking For

Experience selling to developers on a technical, API-first product with a developer dashboard, not a B2B SaaS platform candidates sign up for and self-manage. This is a hard requirement.A track record of owning a campaign end to end: you can walk through, in detail, how you align stakeholders, launch, measure, and report on a campaign from a template through to results.Genuine curiosity and a love of learning: going deep on a single product area and wide across an entire platform both excite you.Creative instincts: you notice good brand and campaign work in the wild, and you bring visual or conceptual ideas that make a technical launch land.Experience leading a large, high-visibility project end to end, e.g., a website overhaul, a rebrand, or a sales enablement overhaul.Strong cross-functional operator: Product and Engineering partners trust you and want to work with you again.Bias for speed and pragmatism: you default to "how do I get this out the door as fast and sharply as possible," not "how do I make this perfect."Genuine enthusiasm for AI and how it's changing marketing and the developer tools landscape.

Nice to Haves

Experience marketing to enterprise customers, especially financial services.Breadth of experience marketing to developers across crypto/Web3 verticals.Experience as a software engineer prior to marketing.Leadership or management experience, or a clear interest in growing into it.

Benefits And Perks

🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision

💪 Gym Reimbursement

🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget

🥙 In-Office Group Meals

🚅 Commuter Benefits

🌴 Flexible Time Off

🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental Health Perks

🧠 Learning & Development Stipend

🌎 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events

💸 HSA and FSA Plans

🧬 Fertility Benefits

Alchemy is committed to offering competitive compensation, including base salary as well as bonus and equity. Additionally, Alchemy offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as other benefits such as 401k and unlimited flexible time off.

Compensation Range: $160K - $200K

Goldman Sachs Marketing

Led by the firm’s first Chief Marketing Officer, the marketing function at Goldman Sachs is backed by momentum and a broad imperative to unify the discipline, helping to codify a business-critical function seen as core to the firm’s future growth. As such, GS is focused on building out a data-and-technology enabled team of growth marketers, delivering value for the brand and the business. The organization will consist of a number of key COE roles in areas such as Brand, Media, and Marketing Strategy, as well as marketing leads for each of our revenue divisions. Together, this team will collaborate to build a unified, scalable, and consistent approach to marketing the brand and its offerings. Our mission is to be a demonstrable force multiplier for the businesses we serve.

Within the Global Marketing function but aligned to the Global Banking and Markets division, sits the Transaction Banking marketing team, responsible for end-to-end marketing strategies and programs for the entirety of the division. Working across the core elements of the franchise -- the team leads messaging strategy, content creation, client engagement strategy, digital marketing, and marketing analytics.

We aim to build a modern and digital-first transaction banking solution to serve our clients. Our business combines the strength, heritage, and expertise of a 150-year-old firm with the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of a tech start-up. Our goal is to provide a best-in-class digital product that helps clients to succeed by giving them a holistic view of their business. Work closely with product and coverage teams to develop and execute bespoke marketing content around TxB products Lead and project manage external agencies for the end-to-end creation, design, and amplification of key marketing assets. At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

rows.title: Financial Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Build Our Future Together

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Financial Analyst, R&D Finance, to serve as a key partner in supporting the Research and Preclinical (R&pD) organizations business. This role will primarily support the preclinical function of the R&pD organization. In this role you will be responsible for budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, variance analysis, financial modeling and other ad hoc financial duties. Key aspects of the role include cost center reporting, accrual calculations, compiling program budgets, study forecasting on a cost center basis and working on external collaborations. This role requires strong financial acumen, attention to detail and accuracy, an eagerness to learn, as well as an ability to work cross-functionally with teams to gather assumptions. The candidate should be able to both communicate effectively and quickly develop trusted relationships with all levels across R&pD and Financial Services functions.

DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.

This candidate will serve as a Data Scientist in NYC DOT’s Bike Share & Shared Mobility unit, which is responsible for planning and oversight of the Citi Bike program and other shared micro mobility services in New York City. Citi Bike is a public transportation service and a public-private partnership that is among the largest and most successful bike share systems in the world. The program is in the midst of a five-year expansion that will ultimately double the size of its previous service area and put more than 40,000 bicycles within a five-minute walk of half of NYC residents. Other shared micro-mobility services in NYC include dockless e-scooter and e-moped shares.

We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our team and play a pivotal role in shaping how we understand, monitor, and optimize our shared mobility systems. This individual will combine data analytics, advanced visualization, and strategic storytelling to translate complex data from Citi Bike and Shared E-Scooter programs into actionable insights that inform planning and day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of analytics and communication - able to uncover patterns, craft compelling narratives, and partner with internal team members at all levels to drive informed decision-making.

Reporting to the Director of Data Science, the Data Scientist will be responsible for, but not limited to:

Data Analytics & Research

 Conduct research and analysis on bike share and shared mobility to inform current and future planning Prepare reports and briefing materials based on the databases that underlie the bike share and shared mobility systems Monitor vendor compliance with governmental regulations, DOT policies, and contract terms Develop predictive models to answer complex and nuanced questions about the programs and anticipate future needs and behavior of the systems Respond quickly and accurately to ad hoc data requests for internal and external stakeholders

Visualization & Storytelling

 Develop and maintain dashboards to deliver insights to internal team members using software such as Power BITranslate data into stories that resonate with senior staff, managers, and staff, highlighting both the "what" and the "why"

Strategic Thinking & Partnership

 Collaborate with leadership, Operations, Planning, and Policy teams to align analytics and research agendas with organizational priorities Offer evidence-based recommendations to support system planning, managing existing service areas, and shaping future policy decisions Act as a trusted advisor and build strong relationships with the internal team members.

Data Management

 Monitor data quality, identify issues, and maintain data integrity. Document data management procedures (e.g., data dictionaries, business rules) Plan, design, maintain, and support unit internal databases

CITY RESEARCH SCIENTIST - 21744

Minimum Qualifications

 For Assignment Level I (only physical, biological and environmental sciences and public health) A master's degree from an accredited college or university with a specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological or environmental science or in public health.

To be appointed to Assignment Level II and above, candidates must have:

 A doctorate degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and one year of full-time experience in a responsible supervisory, administrative or research capacity in the appropriate field of specialization; or A master's degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and three years of responsible full-time research experience in the appropriate field of specialization; or Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least a master's degree in an appropriate field of specialization and at least two years of experience described in "2" above. Two years as a City Research Scientist Level I can be substituted for the experience required in "1" and "2" above.

Note

Probationary Period

Appointments to this position are subject to a minimum probationary period of one year.

Preferred Skills

Preferred Skills - Mastery with spreadsheets and at least one coding language (Python, R, etc.) for data manipulation - Experience in querying, cleaning, and maintaining large relational databases using SQL - Experience with data visualization software such as Power BI and/or Tableau - Strong familiarity with providing statistical support by participating in the development of statistical methodology, study design, and data analysis of analytical projects - Mastery with presentation slides, data visualization software, maps, and memos. This includes leveraging visualization tools to present information in a way that drives fact-based decision making by developing intuitive static and interactive data graphics - Ability to relate complex trends in the data to larger policy issues, to work with the operations and planning team to tailor data analysis and products to their needs -Excellent interpersonal, analytical, research, presentation, written, and oral communication skills -Willingness to be flexible and work as part of a team -Experience or interest in transportation planning, logistics, bike share, micro mobility, cycling, and working with or in the public sector.

Public Service Loan Forgiveness

As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/.

Residency Requirement

New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview.

Additional Information

The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy.

Numberly est reconnu comme l’un des meilleurs spécialistes mondiaux du Data Marketing avec près de 500 collaborateurs et 11 bureaux dans le monde au service de plus de 300 clients de premier plan (L'Oréal, Groupe Seb, Pernod Ricard, Kellogg's, Colgate, Hills, SNCF, Aigle, HSBC, Arte, L’Occitane...). Numberly s’appuie sur les avancées les plus récentes en matière de traitement, d’analyse et d’activation media des données dans un contexte vertueux alliant compétitivité des entreprises et respect renforcé de la vie privée et de la protection des données.

Description du poste

Au croisement du Marketing, du Data Engineering, des Clean Rooms et de l'IA, vous contribuerez activement aux grands projets Data pour participer à la mise en valeur des données de nos clients et de leurs partenaires, tout en accompagnant l'intégration de l'IA et l'automatisation de nos processus.

Le/la VIE sera intégré·e à l'équipe Data du bureau de New York et bénéficiera d'un accompagnement quotidien par son manager local ou sa manageuse locale.

Passionné·e par la data collaboration et l'impact de l'IA sur la transformation de projets complexes ? Rejoignez-nous !

Poste à pourvoir en septembre/octobre 2026.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes éligible au contrat VIE (ressortissant·e de l'Espace Économique Européen, âgé·e de 18 à 28 ans au début de la mission).Vous êtes diplômé·e d'une grande école d'Ingénieur ou d'un Master universitaire en Data, Informatique ou Management de la Technologie.Vous avez une première expérience (stage/alternance/CDI) réussie en gestion de projets Data et possédez de fortes capacités analytiques.Vous avez une sensibilité ou une première expérience sur les sujets d’IA et d’automatisation, vous vous intéressez à l'usage des LLMs, vous comprenez le fonctionnement des architectures agentiques/multi-agents et souhaitez développer vos compétences pour faire communiquer des applications et APIs entre elles.Une connaissance ou un intérêt marqué pour la création de Skills, de MCPs et de processus agentiques sera apprécié.Approche Think & Do : vous aimez tester des outils, créer, vous tromper pour apprendre et concevoir des architectures innovantes.La connaissance (ou une appétence pour l'apprentissage) de ces langages et outils serait un plus : SQL, Spark, Python, DAX, tracking et outils de gestion de campagnes.Anglais courant (écrit et oral) indispensable pour accompagner des clients nord-américains.

Job Description Summary

The AI Business Enablement Analyst supports the adoption and effective use of generative AI across the Investment Bank and Capital Markets & Advisory functions by designing, building, and improving AI-powered solutions across banker workflows through skills and prompts and emerging agent-based tools. This role blends technical curiosity with practical application and deep financial services knowledge, contributing to prompt engineering, solution development, and user support while maintaining best practices and documentation. The individual partners with stakeholders to deliver training, troubleshoot issues, and enhance user experience, while also evaluating technology trends and vendors to drive innovation and business value.

Responsibilities

Job Description

 This role will directly support the Investment Bank and Capital Markets & Advisory function and its use of generative AI, including GPTs and future agent-based solutions. Support the design, development, testing, and ongoing improvement of GPTs, AI-powered workflows, and (over time) agent-based solutions Assist with prompt engineering, prompt optimization, and documentation of effective prompting patterns and use cases Help maintain standards, best practices, and internal documentation related to AI tools, automation, and innovation platforms Provide hands-on support to internal users, helping troubleshoot issues and improve overall user experience with AI-enabled tools Design and deliver role-specific training to investment bankers and finance professionals Contribute to short- and long-term innovation roadmaps through research, analysis, and execution support Analyze technology trends, tools, and vendor offerings to identify opportunities for experimentation or business value Generate insights and recommendations that help improve internal technology offerings and identify areas for growth Assist with data analysis and reporting related to innovation initiatives, pilots, and outcomes Create and maintain presentation materials, including PowerPoint decks, charts, and visuals for leadership and stakeholder updates Facilitate meetings with internal teams and external vendors; capture notes, actions, and follow-ups Draft concise summaries, reports, or briefing materials on technology topics, vendors, or pilot results Contribute ideas and perspectives to brainstorming sessions and innovation ideation efforts

Skills

 The ideal candidate is curious and excited about applying emerging technologies—especially generative AI—to real business problems. 1–4 years of experience in finance, technology, software, digital innovation, or related roles (investment banking or capital markets exposure a plus, but not required) Strong interest in generative AI, automation, and modern software platforms (e.g., LLMs, GPTs, agents, APIs, low-code/no-code tools) Proficiency in data analysis using advanced Excel (e.g., pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, conditional logic) to support reporting, pilot measurement, and business case development Experience supporting or managing vendors, including coordination around licenses, contracts, or service delivery Working knowledge of project and program management fundamentals Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapt quickly as priorities and technologies change Demonstrated ability to think creatively and encourage new approaches or ways of working Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical or complex concepts clearly and concisely Comfortable creating and interpreting charts, diagrams, tables, and other data visualizations Genuine interest in following technology trends, innovation research, and emerging tools Excellent verbal communication and collaboration skills High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders

What Success Looks Like

 High-value AI use cases are moved from idea to pilot to scaled adoption. Solutions are deployed with clear testing, documentation, and governance controls. Banker adoption increases and workflows show measurable improvement in speed, quality, or user experience. The team develops reusable assets and a repeatable operating model rather than one-off prompts.

Education

 Bachelor’s degree in finance, computer science, engineering, information systems, data science, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 General Experience - 1 to 6 years

The Division of Quality Improvement (DQI) is responsible for developing and implementing key components of OPWDD's mission. Duties Description

The Division of Quality Improvement (DQI) is responsible for developing and implementing key components of OPWDD's mission. A central objective of DQI is to integrate and promote quality improvement practices across the service system to enhance the quality of support and outcomes for the people we serve.

The incumbent will serve as a core member of the DQI Data Analysis and Evaluation Unit (DAEU), supporting expanding data analysis and reporting needs and assisting with new federal requirements. DQI is responsible for overseeing implementation of the federal Access Rule quality measure set issued by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). The incumbent will contribute to analyses and reporting related to critical incidents and the Incident Report and Management Application (IRMA), including tasks required under the Access Rule.

This position will be essential to many data analysis functions and initiatives central to DQI.

The incumbent will be expected to:

 Perform structured data analysis using quantitative, statistical, and operational methodologies.  Extract, clean, merge, and prepare datasets from OPWDD, Medicaid, and other enterprise systems using SQL, SAS, and similar tools.  Develop analytic outputs including frequencies, trends, quality indicators, and operational metrics.  Develop visualizations, summaries, dashboards, and reports in both paper and presentation formats.  Support data-driven decision-making through clear, reliable, and audit-ready reporting.  Support implementation of CMS Access Rule quality requirements through data preparation, metric development, validation, and reporting.  Assist with IRMA federal reporting changes required under the Access Rule.  Identify potential unreported critical incidents using Medicaid data and structured analytic methods.  Trend statewide incident data in collaboration with SCIR to support prevention of harm, abuse, and neglect.  Coordinate with DSM and partner agencies to align data structures, integrate data sources, and support enterprise data strategy.  Use SQL, SAS, Tableau, and other analytic tools to meet reporting and data processing needs.  Apply Medicaid data knowledge when working on incident-related analytics and Access Rule requirements. About Finch

We are on a mission to revolutionize employment by building the infrastructure that powers every facet of work . To do this, we're looking for individuals who think about problems holistically and in-depth, who are relentlessly curious, self-starters, and determined to drive ideas from inception through to completion.

Finch is a Series B company backed by a fantastic set of firms, angels, and our developers including General Catalyst, Menlo Ventures, Homebrew, BoxGroup, YCombinator, Charley (1st business hire at Plaid), Sima (ex-Head of Biz Dev at Plaid), Henrique + Pedro (co-CEOs at Brex), Jeff + Wayne (co-CEOs at Digits), Immad (CEO at Mercury), Sam (CEO at Vouch Insurance), Karim (CTO at Ramp), and more.

About Our Team

We're a team of problem solvers who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We value velocity, curiosity, empathy, and diverse perspectives. Everyone on the team is excited about the scope of the problems we address and the potential impact our work can have on the global workforce. We realize that the value we provide comes with great responsibilities, and therefore make security and privacy our highest priorities.

We come from a diverse set of backgrounds and each member brings different skills to the group. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and potential will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns.

About The Role

We're looking for a data-driven Product Analyst to support SLA monitoring and tracking, provider expansion, and automation initiatives. This role owns operational workflows end-to-end with a strong emphasis on metrics, tracking, and identifying where processes are off track. This individual will partner closely with product, integrations, and engineering to move work from manual support toward scalable automation.
