rows.title: Software Developer - Spring Co-Op 2027 - Cambridge
rows.descriptionText:
Introduction

At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.

Your Role And Responsibilities

This is a 16-week Co-op position designed for actively enrolled undergraduate students who are interested in gaining hands-on, practical experience while contributing to real IBM engineering projects. To be eligible, candidates must be currently enrolled at an accredited university and able to pause their coursework for the duration of the Co-op, as students may not be enrolled in classes while participating. This role requires full-time availability (40 hours per week) during the Spring 2027 semester between January 19 and May 7, 2027. Eligible candidates should also be available to join IBM in a full-time role between December 2027 and August 2028 upon successful completion of their degree. We are looking for Software Developer Co-op students to join an engineering team building technologies for AI agents, large language models, evaluation, observability, optimization, and cloud-native AI systems. As a Co-op student, you will work alongside experienced IBM engineers to design, build, test, and operate software used to understand and improve the behavior of AI applications. Depending on the project, you may contribute to SDKs, APIs, distributed backend services, developer tools, user interfaces, or infrastructure. This role is designed for students who are passionate about software engineering and interested in the rapidly evolving intersection of AI, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and developer platforms. Prior experience with AI agents is not required. We value strong software fundamentals, technical curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly. You will gain hands-on experience working on production systems, modern cloud-native technologies, and engineering challenges associated with deploying and improving AI applications at scale.

What You’ll Do

 Support the design, development, testing, and debugging of software across front-end, back-end, infrastructure, and full-stack environments. Build capabilities that help developers evaluate, observe, debug, benchmark, and optimize AI agents and generative AI applications. Work with large language models and AI agents to analyze behaviors such as tool usage, responses, execution traces, latency, quality, and cost. Help develop automated evaluation and testing systems for AI applications, including test-case generation, behavioral metrics, benchmarking, and regression testing. Build services and APIs that collect, process, and analyze telemetry and evaluation data from distributed AI applications. Contribute to SDKs and integrations that connect with different AI models, agent runtimes, and development frameworks. Explore techniques for improving the quality and efficiency of AI systems through prompt optimization, model selection, tool optimization, and automated experimentation. Work with a variety of programming languages depending on the project, including Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++, Go, Rust, Swift, Kotlin, or others. Help build user interfaces using frameworks such as React, or contribute to backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. Work with cloud and container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, REST APIs, and cloud-native services. Use Git and other version-control, CI/CD, and collaboration tools. Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, Agile development, and collaboration with engineers, researchers, product managers, and designers. Explore emerging technologies in agentic AI, LLM evaluation, observability, optimization, automation, and cloud-native development.

Location Flexibility

By applying to this requisition, you acknowledge and agree to be considered for any of the listed locations associated with this position and are willing to work at the location where you are ultimately assigned.

Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

 Must be actively enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree program at the time of application and returning to complete the degree after the Co-op. Available to start full-time between December 2027 and August 2028. Available to work full-time 40 hours per week at an IBM location for 16 weeks between January 19 and May 7, 2027. The Co-op requires a full-time commitment; students should not be enrolled in concurrent coursework during the Co-op term.

Transferable skills and experience from coursework, internships, research, personal projects, or open-source contributions are encouraged.

 Coursework or project experience in software development using at least one programming language. Familiarity with fundamental computer science concepts such as data structures, algorithms, debugging, APIs, and software design. Exposure to front-end or back-end technologies such as React, Node.js, Python, Java, SQL, Go, or similar technologies. Experience using Git or a similar version-control system. Interest in AI systems, large language models, AI agents, cloud computing, containers, distributed systems, or developer tooling. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively and learn new technologies quickly in a team environment

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

 Experience experimenting with large language models, generative AI, or AI agents. Familiarity with AI or agent development frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar technologies. Exposure to concepts such as LLM evaluation, tracing, observability, benchmarking, prompt engineering, or model optimization. Experience with cloud services such as IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure, or GCP. Familiarity with REST APIs and relational or NoSQL databases. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other container technologies. Familiarity with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics, and logging. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, automation tools, or cloud-native deployment practices. Personal, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate creativity, initiative, and technical curiosity. Understanding of Agile software development methods.

rows.title: Quantum Algorithms Engineer Intern 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Introduction

At IBM Quantum, our mission is to bring useful quantum computing to the world by advancing quantum hardware, software, and algorithms. This internship provides an opportunity to contribute to research at the intersection of quantum algorithms, quantum software, and quantum hardware.

The intern will work with researchers and engineers to develop, implement, and evaluate quantum algorithms for challenging problems in areas such as chemistry, materials science, optimization, and quantum machine learning. The work will involve using Qiskit and IBM Quantum systems to design experiments, benchmark algorithms, investigate scalability, and explore techniques for improving performance on current quantum processors.

This is a research-oriented internship intended for a highly motivated graduate student who is interested in translating advances in quantum computing into practical demonstrations and scientific results. The intern will have opportunities to contribute to research prototypes, technical publications, and collaborations across IBM Quantum.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quantum Algorithm Engineer Intern, you will contribute to research and development of quantum algorithms and their implementation on near-term quantum computers. You will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, quantum software, and quantum hardware, with opportunities to explore applications in areas such as chemistry, materials science, optimization, and quantum machine learning.

The intern will work closely with quantum researchers and engineers to investigate algorithmic approaches, implement and benchmark quantum circuits, and evaluate their performance using both classical simulation and real quantum processors. The position will provide an opportunity to contribute to research prototypes, technical demonstrations, and scientific publications.

Key Responsibilities Include

Research and implement quantum algorithms for practical scientific and computational problems.Develop and optimize quantum circuits using Qiskit and the IBM Quantum software stack.Execute experiments on real quantum processors and analyze experimental results.Investigate techniques for improving circuit performance, including transpilation, circuit optimization, error suppression, and error mitigation. Benchmark quantum algorithms using appropriate classical baselines and simulation methods.Analyze the scalability and computational requirements of quantum algorithms and identify potential bottlenecks.Contribute to research prototypes, technical demonstrations, and software implementations.Collaborate with researchers and engineers across quantum algorithms, software, and applications.

Preferred Education

Doctorate Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Currently pursuing a Ph.D. or Master's degree in Physics, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field, with research focused on quantum computing or a closely related area.Strong understanding of fundamental concepts in quantum computing, quantum information, and quantum algorithms.Hands-on experience implementing quantum algorithms using Python and at least one quantum computing SDK, preferably Qiskit.Experience with numerical computing and scientific programming in Python, including commonly used scientific computing libraries.Ability to independently formulate technical problems, design experiments, analyze results, and communicate conclusions.Experience conducting academic or industrial research, preferably with research publications or conference contributions.Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.Ability to work collaboratively in a research and engineering environment.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Experience executing quantum algorithms on real quantum processors.Familiarity with the IBM Quantum platform, Qiskit Runtime, and Qiskit workflows.Experience with quantum circuit optimization, transpilation, error suppression, or error mitigation.Knowledge of variational quantum algorithms, quantum simulation, quantum chemistry, quantum optimization, or quantum machine learning.Experience benchmarking quantum algorithms against classical methods or simulators.Familiarity with tensor-network methods, MPS simulation, stabilizer simulation, or other approaches for assessing classical simulability of quantum circuits.Experience with HPC or hybrid quantum-classical computing workflows.Familiarity with software engineering practices such as Git, testing, documentation, and reproducible research.Demonstrated ability to work across disciplinary boundaries and communicate technical concepts to researchers and engineers from different backgrounds.

rows.title: Secure Systems and AI Security Researcher / Engineer (Early Career)
rows.descriptionText:
The Secure Resilient Systems and Technology group advances cybersecurity research to address critical national security challenges. We develop and evaluate technologies that enable mission systems, from space and autonomous platforms to tactical communications and secure computing, to withstand cyberattack and continue the mission. Our goal is not simply to identify vulnerabilities, but to design security in from the start and provide rigorous evidence that these systems can be trusted under attack.

Our research spans secure software and embedded systems, security architecture and threat modeling, applied cryptography, formal methods, and security evaluation, as well as the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, including both AI for cybersecurity and cybersecurity for AI. We work across the R&D lifecycle, from new concepts through prototyping and transition to mission use, collaborating across Lincoln Laboratory and with government, industry, and academia.

We are a collegial and mission-driven team working on difficult problems where security, resilience, assurance, performance, and operational realities all matter. We value technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, inclusion, and individual growth. Our culture emphasizes mentoring and developing researchers into PIs and technical leaders. We strive to bring out the best in our people and our systems, so that the Laboratory and the nation can count on them when it matters most.

If you would like to pursue cutting-edge research and work on things that truly matter at a place that combines MIT's culture of academic excellence, exceptional resources, and strong work-life balance, apply here to learn more.

Job Description

As an Assistant Technical Staff member, you will:

Research, design, prototype, and evaluate new approaches to securing software, embedded, and communication systems against sophisticated cyber threats.Develop high-quality software and experimental systems using Rust, C/C++, and other languages appropriate to the research.Explore problems at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, including applications of AI to cyber analysis and defense, as well as the security and evaluation of AI-enabled systems.Collaborate with researchers and engineers across cybersecurity, cryptography, formal methods, AI, communications, autonomy, space, and other disciplines.Present results to Laboratory and government stakeholders and contribute to reports, publications, prototypes, reusable software, and the transition of successful technologies to operational use.


Required Qualifications

To thrive in this role, you should have: 

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.Demonstrated proficiency in at least one of the following:Software design, development, and testing in Rust (preferred), C/C++, or another systems programming language.Secure software or systems security.Systems integration, testing, and evaluation of secure systems.Embedded systems analysis, design, and implementation.Substantial hands-on technical experience beyond academic coursework, typically equivalent to at least six months of full-time technical experience, gained through internships, co-ops, research appointments, employment, or comparable experience. A significant portion must be directly relevant to cybersecurity, systems security, secure software, embedded systems, or AI security.Strong problem-solving and technical communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in teams.

Desired Experience And Expertise

We particularly value demonstrated experience in one or more of the following:

Systems engineering, security requirements analysis, and threat modeling.Security evaluation and assurance, including adversarial testing, experimental methods, security measurement, and evidence supporting security and assurance claims.Secure software development, operating system internals, embedded systems security, and network protocols.Applied cryptography and protocols, including industry and government standards.Static and dynamic software analysis and applied formal methods.AI and cybersecurity, including AI-enabled software analysis, vulnerability discovery, security testing, threat analysis, and cyber defense; and security of AI-enabled systems, including adversarial threats and evaluation of security, robustness, and resilience.Technical communication, including documenting designs, writing reports and research papers, and presenting technical results.


We do not expect candidates to have expertise in all of these areas and welcome candidates interested in developing deeper expertise through hands-on research.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

This application is for a 6-month student role from January - June 2027. Resume review begins in October 2026.

The co-op will join the Data Visualization and Application Development (DVAD) team within Quantitative Sciences and Development Operations (QSDO). DVAD builds and supports applications, data products, and visualizations that help stakeholders consume data in an efficient way while making better informed decisions. This role is for a student who can engage with users to understand their needs, is curious about how technology can improve work, and is interested in gathering user evaluation metrics to shape a successful product.

The role will be divided across two connected areas. Some of the co-op's time will support a centralized clinical trial operations platform. The co-op will help develop an evaluation plan for gathering user feedback, support implementation of the evaluation approach, and analyze and report on responses. The goal will be to evaluate adoption, understand how the tool is being used, identify barriers or unmet needs, and recommend areas for improvement. 

The remaining time will support project management and information gathering to identify visualizations that could be useful across QSDO. This may include interviewing stakeholders, documenting business questions and user needs, organizing and synthesizing findings, tracking activities and decisions, and helping the DVAD team assess and prioritize potential visualization opportunities. 

Success will depend on curiosity, thoughtful problem solving, strong communication, attention to detail, and a user-centered perspective. What You’ll Do

Partner with the clinical operations platform team to develop an evaluation plan, including evaluation questions, target audiences, feedback methods, measures of adoption, and a practical approach for collecting and reviewing responses.  Support implementation of the evaluation plan by preparing materials, coordinating outreach, organizing responses, and maintaining clear and appropriate documentation.  Create a clear evaluation report that summarizes the approach, findings, limitations, and prioritized recommendations for future improvements. Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

APPLY BY EMAIL ONLY - APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS BELOW

The proposed project involves advancing polarization sensitive optical coherence tomography (PSOCT) to reveal the 3D neuronal architecture and connectivity in the developmental cerebellum. The overarching goal is to map the cerebellum development in the first years and to understand the impact of prematurity (preterm infants) in cerebellum growth and the overall development. We are seeking a highly motivated candidate with an interest in biomedical optics and neuroimaging. The candidate will be working directly with Drs Hui Wang and Lilla Zollei, integrated into the Hui Wang Lab, part of Laboratories for Computational Neuroimaging (https://lcn.martinos.org/) at the Athinoula A. Martinos Center for Biomedical Imaging, Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard Medical School. When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Position Overview

The Mavrikaki Lab at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC) and Harvard Medical School is seeking a highly motivated and creative junior Postdoctoral Research Fellow to lead high-impact studies investigating the molecular mechanisms driving brain aging and cognitive decline.

Our laboratory integrates spatial transcriptomics, multi-omic approaches, advanced molecular biology, and in vivo mouse models to resolve key pathways underlying brain aging. Building upon our recent landmark work—including spatial transcriptomic and microRNA atlases of the adult lifespan human prefrontal cortex—the successful candidate will drive research exploring how specific cell populations regulate age-related cognitive function.

Key Responsibilities

 Multi-Omics & Molecular Profiling: Design and execute multi-omic pipelines (including spatial transcriptomics and bulk RNA-seq) alongside targeted tissue validation assays (RNAscope, RT-qPCR, immunohistochemistry). In Vivo Rodent Studies: Lead rodent research utilizing stereotaxic viral deliveries, targeted manipulations, and behavioral phenotyping focused on cognitive assessment. In Vitro Target Validation: Contribute to the design of cell-based assays to functionally validate candidate molecular targets. Leadership & Mentorship: Collaborate across interdisciplinary teams, mentor junior laboratory members, and take a primary role in manuscript preparation, data presentation, and grant development.

 Education: Ph.D. in Neuroscience, Molecular Biology, or a closely related discipline. 0-2 years of postdoctoral research experience. Technical Expertise:Required: Strong foundational expertise in molecular biology techniques.Highly Preferred: Direct experience with rodent stereotaxic surgeries, and aging research.Preferred: Experience with in situ tissue analysis (RNAscope/spatial assays) or multi-omic datasets. rows.descriptionText:
PCN 2059

Anticipated Start Date: Fall 2026

Funding term: NIH-funded; contingent upon continued receipt of external funding

Position Overview

The Matern Lab at Merrimack College is seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join its NIH- funded research project on inner ear sensory cell biology using organoid models. The successful candidate will work closely with Dr. Maggie Matern and members of a collaborative research team to generate and analyze stem cell-derived inner ear organoids, with the goal of uncovering the molecular mechanisms that drive sensory cell development. To achieve this, the project employs lentiviral approaches to generate novel stem cell tools containing inducible CRISPR constructs. Following inner ear organoid generation, these tools will enable precise temporal control of gene expression in sensory cells, providing new insights into the functions of key developmental genes and the mechanisms that govern sensory cell formation.

The successful candidate will develop independent, hypothesis-driven research while contributing to ongoing projects in the lab. The position includes mentoring undergraduate and graduate researchers, as well as active participation in a collaborative research environment. The lab actively supports postdoctoral fellowship applications and provides mentorship in grant writing and career development.

The Center for Brain Recovery (CBR) at Boston University is a cutting-edge research center focused on understanding mechanisms of language recovery following stroke and developing effective treatments for stroke survivors. Our interdisciplinary team of clinicians, neuroscientists, engineers, and data scientists is dedicated to advancing precision rehabilitation and next-generation neurotechnologies for individuals with aphasia.

Position Overview

The Center for Brain Recovery is seeking a highly motivated and innovative Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team working on two complementary research initiatives. The successful candidate will advance groundbreaking work in understanding how the brain recovers language function after stroke and in developing neuroimaging-based prognostic frameworks to enhance precision rehabilitation, neuromodulation and therapeutics for aphasia. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge research in neuroimaging, computational neuroscience, and precision therapeutics for aphasia recovery.

Key Responsibilities

Neural Network Engagement & Language Recovery Research

Conduct and analyze fMRI studies investigating how different brain networks (language network and domain-general multiple demand network) support language processing in persons with aphasiaEvaluate how intensive language therapy modulates neural engagement across brain networks

Neuroimaging-Based Prognostication & Connectivity Mapping

Develop and refine computational pipelines for analyzing directional temporal-frontal connectivity using advanced neuroimaging data (MRI, DTI, rsfMRI)Build and validate lesion-informed cortical-dynamics simulations to compute patient-specific effective connectivityCreate personalized "digital twins" of patient brains to identify recruitable language function and viable neuroprosthesis targets

Computational Modeling & Machine Learning

Develop machine learning models that predict individual recovery prognosis and treatment response from multimodal neuroimaging and behavioral dataApply interpretable AI methods to identify predictive neural biomarkersValidate prognostic algorithms on independent cohorts and translate findings into clinical candidacy assessments

Clinical Research & Data Management

Coordinate recruitment, screening, and enrollment of stroke survivors with aphasia across varying severity levelsOversee fMRI data collection and quality assuranceManage longitudinal study databases and ensure compliance with ethical research standardsContribute to clinical characterization of participants and behavioral assessments

rows.title: Quantum Algorithms Engineer Intern 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Introduction

At IBM Quantum, our mission is to bring useful quantum computing to the world by advancing quantum hardware, software, and algorithms. This internship provides an opportunity to contribute to research at the intersection of quantum algorithms, quantum software, and quantum hardware.

The intern will work with researchers and engineers to develop, implement, and evaluate quantum algorithms for challenging problems in areas such as chemistry, materials science, optimization, and quantum machine learning. The work will involve using Qiskit and IBM Quantum systems to design experiments, benchmark algorithms, investigate scalability, and explore techniques for improving performance on current quantum processors.

This is a research-oriented internship intended for a highly motivated graduate student who is interested in translating advances in quantum computing into practical demonstrations and scientific results. The intern will have opportunities to contribute to research prototypes, technical publications, and collaborations across IBM Quantum.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quantum Algorithm Engineer Intern, you will contribute to research and development of quantum algorithms and their implementation on near-term quantum computers. You will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, quantum software, and quantum hardware, with opportunities to explore applications in areas such as chemistry, materials science, optimization, and quantum machine learning.

The intern will work closely with quantum researchers and engineers to investigate algorithmic approaches, implement and benchmark quantum circuits, and evaluate their performance using both classical simulation and real quantum processors. The position will provide an opportunity to contribute to research prototypes, technical demonstrations, and scientific publications.

Key Responsibilities Include

Research and implement quantum algorithms for practical scientific and computational problems.Develop and optimize quantum circuits using Qiskit and the IBM Quantum software stack.Execute experiments on real quantum processors and analyze experimental results.Investigate techniques for improving circuit performance, including transpilation, circuit optimization, error suppression, and error mitigation. Benchmark quantum algorithms using appropriate classical baselines and simulation methods.Analyze the scalability and computational requirements of quantum algorithms and identify potential bottlenecks.Contribute to research prototypes, technical demonstrations, and software implementations.Collaborate with researchers and engineers across quantum algorithms, software, and applications.

Preferred Education

Doctorate Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Currently pursuing a Ph.D. or Master's degree in Physics, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field, with research focused on quantum computing or a closely related area.Strong understanding of fundamental concepts in quantum computing, quantum information, and quantum algorithms.Hands-on experience implementing quantum algorithms using Python and at least one quantum computing SDK, preferably Qiskit.Experience with numerical computing and scientific programming in Python, including commonly used scientific computing libraries.Ability to independently formulate technical problems, design experiments, analyze results, and communicate conclusions.Experience conducting academic or industrial research, preferably with research publications or conference contributions.Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.Ability to work collaboratively in a research and engineering environment.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Experience executing quantum algorithms on real quantum processors.Familiarity with the IBM Quantum platform, Qiskit Runtime, and Qiskit workflows.Experience with quantum circuit optimization, transpilation, error suppression, or error mitigation.Knowledge of variational quantum algorithms, quantum simulation, quantum chemistry, quantum optimization, or quantum machine learning.Experience benchmarking quantum algorithms against classical methods or simulators.Familiarity with tensor-network methods, MPS simulation, stabilizer simulation, or other approaches for assessing classical simulability of quantum circuits.Experience with HPC or hybrid quantum-classical computing workflows.Familiarity with software engineering practices such as Git, testing, documentation, and reproducible research.Demonstrated ability to work across disciplinary boundaries and communicate technical concepts to researchers and engineers from different backgrounds.

rows.title: Secure Systems and AI Security Researcher / Engineer (Early Career)
rows.descriptionText:
The Secure Resilient Systems and Technology group advances cybersecurity research to address critical national security challenges. We develop and evaluate technologies that enable mission systems, from space and autonomous platforms to tactical communications and secure computing, to withstand cyberattack and continue the mission. Our goal is not simply to identify vulnerabilities, but to design security in from the start and provide rigorous evidence that these systems can be trusted under attack.

Our research spans secure software and embedded systems, security architecture and threat modeling, applied cryptography, formal methods, and security evaluation, as well as the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, including both AI for cybersecurity and cybersecurity for AI. We work across the R&D lifecycle, from new concepts through prototyping and transition to mission use, collaborating across Lincoln Laboratory and with government, industry, and academia.

We are a collegial and mission-driven team working on difficult problems where security, resilience, assurance, performance, and operational realities all matter. We value technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, inclusion, and individual growth. Our culture emphasizes mentoring and developing researchers into PIs and technical leaders. We strive to bring out the best in our people and our systems, so that the Laboratory and the nation can count on them when it matters most.

If you would like to pursue cutting-edge research and work on things that truly matter at a place that combines MIT's culture of academic excellence, exceptional resources, and strong work-life balance, apply here to learn more.

Job Description

As an Assistant Technical Staff member, you will:

Research, design, prototype, and evaluate new approaches to securing software, embedded, and communication systems against sophisticated cyber threats.Develop high-quality software and experimental systems using Rust, C/C++, and other languages appropriate to the research.Explore problems at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, including applications of AI to cyber analysis and defense, as well as the security and evaluation of AI-enabled systems.Collaborate with researchers and engineers across cybersecurity, cryptography, formal methods, AI, communications, autonomy, space, and other disciplines.Present results to Laboratory and government stakeholders and contribute to reports, publications, prototypes, reusable software, and the transition of successful technologies to operational use.


Required Qualifications

To thrive in this role, you should have: 

A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.Demonstrated proficiency in at least one of the following:Software design, development, and testing in Rust (preferred), C/C++, or another systems programming language.Secure software or systems security.Systems integration, testing, and evaluation of secure systems.Embedded systems analysis, design, and implementation.Substantial hands-on technical experience beyond academic coursework, typically equivalent to at least six months of full-time technical experience, gained through internships, co-ops, research appointments, employment, or comparable experience. A significant portion must be directly relevant to cybersecurity, systems security, secure software, embedded systems, or AI security.Strong problem-solving and technical communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in teams.

Desired Experience And Expertise

We particularly value demonstrated experience in one or more of the following:

Systems engineering, security requirements analysis, and threat modeling.Security evaluation and assurance, including adversarial testing, experimental methods, security measurement, and evidence supporting security and assurance claims.Secure software development, operating system internals, embedded systems security, and network protocols.Applied cryptography and protocols, including industry and government standards.Static and dynamic software analysis and applied formal methods.AI and cybersecurity, including AI-enabled software analysis, vulnerability discovery, security testing, threat analysis, and cyber defense; and security of AI-enabled systems, including adversarial threats and evaluation of security, robustness, and resilience.Technical communication, including documenting designs, writing reports and research papers, and presenting technical results.


We do not expect candidates to have expertise in all of these areas and welcome candidates interested in developing deeper expertise through hands-on research.

rows.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow - Optical Imaging in Neuroimaging
rows.descriptionText:
Site: Massachusetts General Physicians Organization, Inc.

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

APPLY BY EMAIL ONLY - APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS BELOW

The proposed project involves advancing polarization sensitive optical coherence tomography (PSOCT) to reveal the 3D neuronal architecture and connectivity in the developmental cerebellum. The overarching goal is to map the cerebellum development in the first years and to understand the impact of prematurity (preterm infants) in cerebellum growth and the overall development. We are seeking a highly motivated candidate with an interest in biomedical optics and neuroimaging. The candidate will be working directly with Drs Hui Wang and Lilla Zollei, integrated into the Hui Wang Lab, part of Laboratories for Computational Neuroimaging (https://lcn.martinos.org/) at the Athinoula A. Martinos Center for Biomedical Imaging, Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard Medical School. This project involves a highly collaborative environment and interaction with multidisciplinary teams. The Fellow will obtain training in independent research and grant writing and will have great opportunities to launch an independent investigation.

The Wang lab develops novel optical imaging tools that combines with MRI, molecular labeling, and computational modeling to study the underlying structures supporting the complex functions in the brain. One focus area is to develop next generation large-scale microscopic imaging techniques to map the neuroarchitecture, vasculature, and connectivity in the whole brain and study alternations in neurological disorders.

Responsibilities

 Optical system design, test, and characterization. Volumetric microscopy data processing, physical model based data analysis, and data interpretation. Experimental design; work with research technicians to conduct data collection and analysis. Present progresses to our collaborators and in scientific conferences; publish the work in a timely manner; support future grant applications. Collaborate with other research members and clinical staff to further advance the goals of the research project

Qualifications

Qualification requirements:

Ph.D. in optics, biomedical engineering, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field.Strong research background in biomedical optics, microscopy, or optical engineering.Ability to work independently and with additional training to become an independent researcher.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated by publication and conference presentation records.Experience with optical design, simulation, 3D CAD design, and programing language in control, DAQ, and real time data processing is desired.Research experience with polarization sensitive optical coherence tomography is a strong plus.Strong computational skills, such as signal processing, optimization, or machine learning is a plus.Research experience in neuroimaging is preferred, but not required.

The appointment is for two years with the possibility of continuation based on annual performance evaluation.

The salary range for this position is $71,750 to $73,544 annually.

Please do not apply through the Workday “Apply” button.

This Position Is Being Posted For Informational Purposes Only. To Be Considered, Please Submit The Following Directly To The Hiring Manager By Clicking The Link Below

CV/resumeCover letter describing research interests and experienceContact information for three references

rows.title: Senior Commercial Development Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Nestlé’s Coffee & Beverage Division is home to some of the most dynamic and fastest-growing categories in retail, bringing to life brands that elevate everyday rituals and create meaningful connections with consumers. Within this exciting portfolio, this role plays a critical role in driving growth for iconic brands such as Starbucks and Natural Bliss. As a Senior Analyst, Commercial Development, this role specifically supports the Enhancers business by translating category, customer, and channel insights into actions that strengthen performance across Walmart and Strategic Growth Channel retailers. This position sits at the intersection of analytics, commercial strategy, and customer execution, helping deliver growth by supporting the plans, insights, and tools that enable our teams to win in market.

Job Summary

This Senior Analyst, Commercial Development position supports the Commercial Development organization through analytics, reporting, sales presentation development, and cross-functional coordination. The role helps translate category, customer, and channel insights into actionable commercial plans that support business growth, strengthen field sales execution, and improve decision-making across the organization. This position also partners closely with Commercial Development Managers and cross-functional teams to support customer planning, deployment activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Summary Of Key Responsibilities

Support Commercial Development Managers in developing 4P tactics by channel and customer, including brand objectives, growth drivers, category roadmap strategies, activation tactics, and new item plans.Provide support for ad hoc reporting, sales presentations, communications, SDB writing, and CAP development activities across the Commercial Development organization.Analyze category, customer, and channel data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable insights that inform commercial strategy.Contribute category and segment insights to selected customers and provide feedback to field sales on business development opportunities.Communicate initiative results and business updates to field sales teams and customers to support execution and alignment.Assist in the development and deployment of CAP presentations and related customer-facing materials.Partner with cross-functional teams, including the Hub and CMI, to leverage standardized reports, business insights, and category growth opportunities in support of the Commercial Development team.Support forecast accuracy, sales performance targets, segmentation, resource allocation, and customer service improvement initiatives.Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to improve processes, analytics, and selling capabilities that add value to customers and the business.

Summary Of Experience

A minimum of 18 months of experience in retail sales required.Experience supporting business performance through analytics, reporting, and sales-related planning activities.Experience developing presentations and business materials to support commercial planning and field sales execution.

Basic Qualifications

High school diploma or GED required.Bachelor’s degree preferred.Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint required.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret multiple data sources and translate insights into actionable recommendations.Strong presentation and communication skills with the ability to develop clear, effective business materials.Ability to manage time effectively, work independently, and execute with minimal direction.Ability to challenge current processes and identify innovative solutions that improve team and business performance.Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to take immediate action to resolve issues and communicate potential impacts to stakeholders.Ability to influence without direct authority and build strong cross-functional relationships.Knowledge of the interrelationship of key business functions, including Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Supply Chain, Technical, and IS/IT.Knowledge of business-driving technology solutions and internal/external industry insights and trends, including tools such as Nielsen, BW, and Source.Understanding of core business processes and fundamentals, including sales and distribution, customer planning and management, financial reporting, training, HR policies, coordinated commercial planning, and Nestlé management and leadership principles.

Salary: $105,767.68 to $162,549.05 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. Contact us at accommodations@nestle.com or please dial 711 and provide this number to the operator: 1-800-321-6467.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Review our applicant privacy notice before applying at https://www.nestlejobs.com/privacy.

rows.title: Software Engineer -  Marketing Systems & Integrations
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Who is USP?

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

Brief Job Overview

The Software Engineer – Marketo is responsible for supporting and enhancing the Marketo platform through technical configuration, integration management, campaign automation, and data governance. This role partners with IT, Marketing Operations, and Sales Operations to ensure scalable, reliable, and compliant marketing automation processes. The engineer owns day‑to‑day platform operations while contributing to system improvements and cross‑system alignment.

How will YOU create impact here at USP?

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Software Engineer - Marketing Systems & Integrations has the following responsibilities:

Support user account creation, access permissions, and role governance across marketing automation and CRM platforms to maintain secure, compliant operations.

Translate stakeholder requirements into technical configurations, reusable templates, and scalable operational solutions within a marketing automation platform (e.g., Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, or similar).

Help maintain platform architecture — folder structures, naming conventions, tokens, and operational program frameworks.

Build and maintain field mappings and synchronization logic between the marketing platform and CRM (e.g., Salesforce), supporting schema alignment and data quality.

Clone, configure, and test forms, landing pages, and web assets in Sandbox and Production environments using HTML/CSS fundamentals.

Troubleshoot sync issues between systems, including field conflicts, validation errors, and API-related failures — with support from senior engineers as needed.

Assist with datatype changes, schema updates, and cross-system compatibility checks to keep integrations stable.

Support Sandbox refresh activities: configuration audits, asset restoration, and sync re-establishment.

Help build and maintain trigger-based campaigns, automated workflows, and nurture programs, learning platform-specific logic on the job.

Assist with segmentation setup, audience management, and basic data governance practices.

Monitor system health and campaign performance dashboards, flagging issues to senior team members.

Support data quality and compliance standards across marketing and CRM systems.

Who is USP Looking For?

The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

1–2 years of experience in a technical, engineering, or systems support role

Working knowledge of HTML and CSS; exposure to basic JavaScript is a plus.

Understanding of how APIs and webhooks work, or strong aptitude to learn integration concepts quickly.

Interest in or exposure to CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) and/or marketing automation platforms — prior hands-on Marketo experience is not required .

Comfort working with structured data: field mapping, data types, and schema logic.

Strong problem-solving instincts and willingness to troubleshoot systematically.

Clear communicator, able to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Additional Desired (Nice To Have, Not Required)

Any exposure to Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, or similar marketing automation tools.

Familiarity with CRM objects (Leads/Contacts/Accounts/Opportunities).

Coursework or personal projects involving REST APIs or third-party integrations (e.g., ad platforms like Google, Meta, or LinkedIn).

Certifications are a plus but not expected at this level (e.g., Marketo Certified Associate/Expert, Salesforce Admin).

Supervisory Responsibilities

None, this is an individual contributor role.

Benefits

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

Compensation

Base Salary Range: USD $89,816 – $113,450.00 annually.

Target Annual Bonus: % Varies based on level of role.

Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate’s skill set, experience, qualifications, equity, and other job-related reasons.

Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.

For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

Job Type Full-Time

rows.title: Post Doctoral Associate
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description Summary

Organization's Summary Statement: The Economo Lab (www.biodivlab.org) at the University of Maryland, College Park is seeking a postdoctoral researcher to work at the interface of biology and computer science using large-scale 3D phenotypic data of animals acquired via micro-CT and related modalities. There are exciting opportunities for large-scale image datasets to supercharge the study of the evolution and ecology of traits, probe the connection between genomic and phenomic variation, and discover new bioinspired design principles. The work will build upon recent advances in high-throughput imaging, including but not limited to the Antscan project (Katzke et al., 2026, Nature Methods), to address biological questions using AI-powered segmentation and comparative methods.

The postdoc will be based at the University of Maryland, but work closely with members in the Biodiversity and Biocomplexity unit (also led by Economo) at the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology, Japan. The hired individual will join a collaborative environment on the UMD campus with opportunities to interact with the Predictive Biology Hub, the Immersive Visualization Research Center, the Maryland Center for Robotics, the University of Maryland Institute for Advanced Computing Sciences, and the Artificial Intelligence Institute of Maryland. The Washington, D.C. region has additional opportunities for interaction in the biodiversity space with a wide range of institutions, non-governmental organizations, and universities.

Strong computational skills are required as well as the ability to work in a team in a professional and collegial manner.

This program is required to provide ongoing support for the agencies Network Operations Center (NOC) and Wireless Network Operations Center (WNOC), which are critical components within the Office of Information and Technology (OIT), Enterprise Infrastructure and Operations Directorate (EIOD), and Network Operations Division (NOD). These centers perform real-time monitoring, proactive maintenance, incident detection and response, problem resolution, and network performance reporting across the agencies nationwide enterprise. They ensure network stability, availability, and the rapid escalation and resolution of technical issues.

This role ensures efficient monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolution of network issues by coordinating task assignments, providing technical guidance, escalating complex issues to higher-tier support, and maintaining operational efficiency. Operating in a 24/7 environment, the Shift Lead plays a critical role in maintaining network stability and delivering exceptional support to customers. This position requires strong technical knowledge, problem-solving skills, and communication abilities to ensure efficient network operations and high-quality support.

 Provide direct oversight and leadership to Tier 1 NOC Analysts during assigned shift to ensure 24x7 monitoring and incident response coverage Monitor network, server, and application systems using enterprise monitoring tools to identify, analyze, and escalate incidents in accordance with established procedures Coordinate shift operations, ensuring incidents, service requests, and alerts are properly triaged, logged, escalated, and resolved within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) Act as first point of escalation for complex Tier 1 issues, providing guidance, troubleshooting support, and communication to higher-tier engineers as required. Ensure effective shift handoff by documenting ongoing issues, incidents, and operational status in logs, reports, and dashboards Oversee incident communications, including initial notifications, status updates, and resolution summaries to stakeholders and management Maintain situational awareness of network health, critical infrastructure, and ongoing incidents to ensure operational continuity Enforce adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), incident response workflows, and change management policies Conduct quality assurance reviews of Tier 1 incident tickets to verify accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards Train, coach, and mentor Tier 1 staff to develop technical and analytical skills, improve response times, and strengthen team performance Support major incident management activities by coordinating Tier 1 response efforts and providing real-time updates to the NOC Manager or Incident Commander Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process gaps, documenting recurring issues, and recommending automation or procedural enhancements Generate and review shift reports, summarizing key incidents, outages, and performance metrics for management review Assist with onboarding new analysts and ensuring all shift personnel maintain familiarity with monitoring tools, ticketing systems, and escalation procedures Ensure compliance with security and confidentiality standards when accessing or communicating system informationRequired Skills:  5 + years of relevant experience Bachelors degree in related technical fields such as Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Networking, and Communication Relevant certifications such as ITIL v3, CompTIA, CCNA A minimum of five (5) years' relevant experience in Tier 1 support operations Strong understanding of network fundamentals, including TCP/IP, routing protocols, network topology, and basic troubleshooting techniques Hands-on experience with network monitoring tools and ticketing systems Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills to identify and resolve network issues efficiently Effective communication skills for interacting with customers, technical teams, and management Strong understanding of network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, switching) Experience with rows.title: Specialist, Product Management
rows.descriptionText:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Specialist, Product Management

Overview

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team—one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

About The Role

The Mastercard Services global product team is seeking a Specialist to support the Mastercard Business Intelligence product. Mastercard Business Intelligence is at the heart of a business intelligence ecosystem built on market data and payment insights, helping customers across the globe make smarter decisions and stay competitive.

This role is focused on product execution, coordination, and delivery support within a global team. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and UX partners to help deliver product features and enhancements. You will contribute to roadmap execution, assist in managing dependencies, track progress, and support issue resolution to ensure timely delivery.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, detail-oriented, and eager to learn, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You are comfortable working in a collaborative environment and contributing to multiple workstreams.

What will you do?

 Build foundational understanding of the platform, integration patterns, and available organizational capabilities Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to support delivery of product features and enhancements Contribute to translating customer needs into product requirements and user stories Support delivery execution by tracking progress, identifying issues, and escalating when needed Understand regional considerations and support development of globally scalable solutions Assist in managing multiple priorities and adapting to shifting goals Collaborate effectively with a globally distributed team across time zones Support prioritization discussions with cross-functional teams (engineering, account management, legal, etc.) Assist in validating delivered functionality against product requirements Contribute to improving the customer journey and overall product experience Support product launches and monitor performance metrics such as adoption and usage Help develop and refine product features, ensuring clarity of requirements for engineering teams Gather and incorporate feedback from stakeholders and customers Use data, research, and competitive analysis to support product decisions and backlog prioritization Maintain product documentation to ensure clarity and accessibility across teams Escalate issues appropriately and coordinate with cross-functional partners for resolution Support post-launch reviews and contribute to continuous product improvement Align with go-to-market activities and timelines Track status and highlight risks within assigned product workstreams Take ownership of assigned tasks and actively seek opportunities to grow and expand skills


All About You

 Demonstrated ability to contribute to product delivery and execution in a team environment Ability to translate customer needs into clear product requirements with guidance Experience working with cross-functional teams including engineering, UX, and business stakeholders Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly convey ideas and updates Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities Comfortable working with data to inform decisions and track performance Experience with data platforms, analytics products, or SaaS solutions is preferred Basic understanding of APIs, platform architecture, and integration patterns Familiarity with AI/ML, data pipelines, or analytics capabilities is a plus


Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.


In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

rows.descriptionText:
The People Strategy and Analytics team at Capital One is on a mission to transform the associate experience – from hiring to onboarding to career development – so that all talent can flourish. As a Principal People Scientist on the People Strategy & Analytics team, you will use organizational science, measurement techniques, behavioral insights, and advanced analytics to help drive that transformation.

Our ideal candidate will display a strong balance of analytical and problem solving skills, business consulting, and communication competencies, as well as the ability to work in a dynamic team environment. You’ll be on a cross-functional team that includes analysts, data scientists, and other people scientists.

This role will primarily specialize in enterprise listening strategies like surveying & measurement design, but will also have frequent opportunities to collaborate with key HR partners in areas like Talent & Performance Management, People Leadership and Diversity, Inclusion, & Belonging. Projects will focus on improving the associate experience and unlocking best practices in the talent strategy space. A typical day will include client consultation, measurement design, program design, insights generation, and analysis.

Your main responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Successful team members demonstrate competencies in these areas:

Purpose: You feel a deep personal connection to improving the associate experience and are motivated by applying organizational science in a mission-driven wayAnalytical thinking: A proven track record of decision making and problem solving based in analytics. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation. Identify opportunities for improvement and use data to make strategic and tactical recommendations. Execution: Develop and test hypotheses, design solutions, assess operational feasibility, support implementation efforts, and develop plans and tools for monitoring outcomes Partnership: Collaborate effectively with other team members and HR clientsBusiness communication: Strong written and oral communication skills, including visualization skills (i.e., able to “tell the story” and highlight key insights in a clear and concise manner that is easily understood by stakeholders)Results focus: Drives for results and achieves important goals; applies strong organizational skills and detail orientation, even amidst ambiguity

Master's degreeAt least 1 year of professional work experience in Industrial and Organizational Psychology OR Organizational Behavior OR Behavioral ScienceAt least 1 year of data analysis experience conducting analyses, and building statistical models in R, Python, or SQLAt least 2 years of experience in consulting with external or internal clients across a variety of seniority levels and technical experience

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in Industrial and Organizational Psychology or Organizational Behavior or Behavioral ScienceAt least 2 years professional work experience in Industrial and Organizational Psychology or Organizational BehaviorKnowledge of advanced statistical methodologies, including regression, or longitudinal analysis, or Bayesian modeling

rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Nestlé’s Coffee & Beverage Division is home to some of the most dynamic and fastest-growing categories in retail, bringing to life brands that elevate everyday rituals and create meaningful connections with consumers. Within this exciting portfolio, this role plays a critical role in driving growth for iconic brands such as Starbucks and Natural Bliss. As a Senior Analyst, Commercial Development, this role specifically supports the Enhancers business by translating category, customer, and channel insights into actions that strengthen performance across Walmart and Strategic Growth Channel retailers. This position sits at the intersection of analytics, commercial strategy, and customer execution, helping deliver growth by supporting the plans, insights, and tools that enable our teams to win in market.

Job Summary

This Senior Analyst, Commercial Development position supports the Commercial Development organization through analytics, reporting, sales presentation development, and cross-functional coordination. The role helps translate category, customer, and channel insights into actionable commercial plans that support business growth, strengthen field sales execution, and improve decision-making across the organization. This position also partners closely with Commercial Development Managers and cross-functional teams to support customer planning, deployment activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Summary Of Key Responsibilities

Support Commercial Development Managers in developing 4P tactics by channel and customer, including brand objectives, growth drivers, category roadmap strategies, activation tactics, and new item plans.Provide support for ad hoc reporting, sales presentations, communications, SDB writing, and CAP development activities across the Commercial Development organization.Analyze category, customer, and channel data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable insights that inform commercial strategy.Contribute category and segment insights to selected customers and provide feedback to field sales on business development opportunities.Communicate initiative results and business updates to field sales teams and customers to support execution and alignment.Assist in the development and deployment of CAP presentations and related customer-facing materials.Partner with cross-functional teams, including the Hub and CMI, to leverage standardized reports, business insights, and category growth opportunities in support of the Commercial Development team.Support forecast accuracy, sales performance targets, segmentation, resource allocation, and customer service improvement initiatives.Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to improve processes, analytics, and selling capabilities that add value to customers and the business.

Summary Of Experience

A minimum of 18 months of experience in retail sales required.Experience supporting business performance through analytics, reporting, and sales-related planning activities.Experience developing presentations and business materials to support commercial planning and field sales execution.

Basic Qualifications

High school diploma or GED required.Bachelor’s degree preferred.Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint required.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret multiple data sources and translate insights into actionable recommendations.Strong presentation and communication skills with the ability to develop clear, effective business materials.Ability to manage time effectively, work independently, and execute with minimal direction.Ability to challenge current processes and identify innovative solutions that improve team and business performance.Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to take immediate action to resolve issues and communicate potential impacts to stakeholders.Ability to influence without direct authority and build strong cross-functional relationships.Knowledge of the interrelationship of key business functions, including Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Supply Chain, Technical, and IS/IT.Knowledge of business-driving technology solutions and internal/external industry insights and trends, including tools such as Nielsen, BW, and Source.Understanding of core business processes and fundamentals, including sales and distribution, customer planning and management, financial reporting, training, HR policies, coordinated commercial planning, and Nestlé management and leadership principles.

Salary: $105,767.68 to $162,549.05 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description:

This role is part of a team of model developers focused on building valuations models for Discover Customer Management programs. The near-term focus is to support Discover integration by fully owning valuations including model development, deployment, and governance. The longer-term scope of the team will be developing more advanced model capabilities and methodologies, monitoring performance, and ongoing stakeholder management. The Model Development team will also partner with the credit program to design the model for destination usage and enable business policies backed by valuations.

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.
