rows.title: Àrd Neach-naidheachd – Poileataigs
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DETAILS

ÌRE NA H-OBRACH: D

CÙMHNANT: Maireannach, Làn-ùine

ROINN: BBC Naidheachdan

ÀITE: Holyrood

TUARASTAL AIR A MHOLADH: £42,000 - £45,000 a rèir sgilean agus eòlas-obrach iomchaidh. Tha an raon tuarastail ris a bheil dùil airson na dreuchd seo a’ nochdadh coimeas a-staigh agus fiosrachadh mun mhargaidh a-muigh. Bidh sioftaichean an lùib na dreuchd seo, agus tha dùil gum bi thu ag obair gu cunbhalach bho Phàrlamaid na h-Alba agus aig làraich eile.

Tha sinn toilichte beachdachadh air dòighean-obrach sùbailte. Ma tha ùidh agad, cuir an cèill do roghainn san tagradh – ged nach eil dleastanas sam bith ort sin a dhèanamh an-dràsta. Bidh obair shùbailte mar phàirt den chòmhradh aig ìre a’ tairgse na h-obrach.

JOB BAND: D

CONTRACT TYPE: Permanent, Full-time

DEPARTMENT: BBC Naidheachdan

LOCATION: Holyrood

PROPOSED SALARY RANGE: £42,000 - £45,000 depending on relevant skills, knowledge and experience. The expected salary range for this role reflects internal benchmarking and external market insights. This role involves shift work, and you will be expected to work regularly from the Scottish Parliament and on location.

We're happy to discuss flexible working. If you'd like to, please indicate your preference in the application – though there's no obligation to do so now. Flexible working will be part of the discussion at offer stage.

AMAS NA DREUCHD

Mar Àrd neach-naidheachd Poileataigs le sgioba BBC Naidheachdan, bidh thu a’ craoladh le ùghdarras, thar ioma-ùrlair air na co-dhùnaidhean a bheir buaidh air coimhearsnachdan na h-Alba, a’ dèanamh cinnteach gu bheil na guthan, na beachdan agus na prìomhachasan aca air an riochdachadh. Bidh thu ag aithris air poileataigs na h-Alba aig gach ìre. Cuidichidh na sgilean naidheachd agad an luchd-èisteachd gus ciall a dhèanamh de na cùisean a tha a toirt buaidh air am beatha. Tro bhith ag innse sgeulachdan ùr-ghnàthach thar ùrlaran didseatach, fuaim, bhidio agus tro na meadhanan sòisealta, bidh thu a’ frithealadh air an luchd-cleachdaidh stèidhichte againn agus luchd-cleachdaidh didseatach ùr. Bidh an obair agad riatanach airson naidheachdan na Gàidhlig san àm ri teachd air feadh Alba.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

As a Senior Politics Reporter with the Gaelic News team, you’ll deliver authoritative, multimedia coverage of the decisions that affect Scottish communities, ensuring their voices, perspectives and priorities are represented. You will be reporting on Scottish Politics at all levels. Your journalism will help audiences make sense of the issues that shape their lives. Through innovative storytelling across digital, audio, video and social platforms, you’ll engage both established audiences and new digital users. You will play a vital role in the future of Gaelic journalism across Scotland.

CARSON AN SGIOBA AGAINN?

Thig a dh’ obair còmhla ri sgioba naidheachd dealasach aig a bheil dleastanas seirbheis phoblach sònraichte: a bhith ag innse do choimhearsnachdan air feadh Alba mu na tha a’ tachairt aig gach ìre de phoileatags na h-Alba agus na Rìoghachd Aonaichte. Bidh cothrom agad craoladh a stiùireadh a nì fìor eadar-dhealachadh, dòighean didseatach is ioma-mheadhain ùr a leasachadh airson sgeulachdan poilitigeach innse, agus cuideachadh le bhith a’ fàs an ath ghinealach de luchd-cleachdaidh naidheachdan Gàidhlig. Ag obair còmhla ri luchd-naidheachd tàlantach air feadh BBC Naidheachdan, leasaichidh tu do sgilean, leudaichidh tu buaidh na h-obrach agad, agus cuiridh tu ri naidheachdan Gàidhlig san àm ri teachd.

WHY JOIN OUR TEAM?

Join a passionate news team with a unique public service mission: informing communities across Scotland about what is happening at all levels of Scottish and UK political life. You'll have the opportunity to drive coverage that makes a real difference, develop innovative digital and multimedia ways of political storytelling, and help grow the next generation of Gaelic news audiences. Working alongside talented journalists across BBC Naidheachdan, you'll develop your skills, expand your impact, and contribute to the future of Gaelic journalism.

PRÌOMH DHLEASTASAN AGUS BUAIDH NA H-OBRACH

Lorg sgeulachdan poilitigeach buntainneach, inntinneach agus ruigsinneach do raon farsaing den luchd-cleachdaidh againn.

Bidh misneachail ag innse sgeulachdan thar ioma-mheadhain, a’ lìbhrigeadh susbaint phoilitigeach beò agus coimiseanaichte thar chruthan is phrògraman didseatach is loidhneach, agus sgileil ann a bhith a’ taghadh an dòigh as fheàrr airson sgeulachdan a làimhseachaidh airson a’ bhuaidh as motha.

Lorg guthan eadar-dhealaichte agus tarraingeach gus na sgeulachdan agad a dhèanamh inntinneach a thuilleadh air a bhith misneachail ann a bhith a’ cumail luchd-poilitigs agus seirbheisich phoblach cunntachail.

Cuir sibh fhèin an cèill chun na h-ìre as àirde ann an Gàidhlig agus Beurla, a’ sgrìobhadh agus a’ craoladh gu sgileil anns an dà chànan.

Dealas làidir do neo-phàirteachd agus a’ dèanamh cinnteach gu bheil a h-uile craoladh poilitigeach againn cothromach, ceart agus le nuans a tha iomchaidh.

Your Key Responsibilities And Impact

Make complex political stories relevant, engaging and accessible to a wide range of audiences.

Confident in multimedia storytelling, delivering live and commissioned political content across digital and linear formats and programmes, and adept at picking the best treatment for each story across outlets for the highest impact.

Seek out diverse and compelling voices in order to make your stories engaging as well as being confident in holding politicians and public servants to account.

Express yourself to the highest standard in Gaelic and English, writing and broadcasting with flair in both languages.

Strong commitment to impartiality and ensuring that all of our political coverage is produced fairly, accurately and with the appropriate nuance.

SGILEAN AGUS EÒLAS

Riatanach

Eòlas dearbhte mar neach-naidheachd ann an àrainneachd seòmar naidheachd. Eòlas air dèiligeadh ri naidheachdan a’ briseadh agus a bhith ag obair gu h-èifeachdach fo chuideam gu ceann-ama teann.Tuigse làidir air poilitigs na h-Alba, a’ gabhail a-steach obair Riaghaltas na h-Alba, Pàrlamaid na h-Alba, riaghaltasan ionadail agus cruth-tìre poilitigeach na Rìoghachd Aonaichte san fharsaingeachd.Sgilean làidir agallaimh, le misneachd ceistean a chur air luchd-poilitigs, oifigearan agus luchd-ùidh aig gach ìre.Comas susbaint inntinneach a chruthachadh thar iomadh ùrlar, a’ gabhail a-steach teacsa, fuaim, bhidio agus na meadhanan sòisealta. Sgilean conaltraidh làidir sgrìobhte agus labhairt ann an Gàidhlig agus Beurla.Deònach siubhal agus obrachadh gu sùbailte mar a dh’ fheumar le tachartasan poilitigeach. Comas cùisean poilitigeach ioma-fhillte a dhèanamh ruigsinneach agus buntainneach do luchd-cleachdaidh measgaichte.

Essential Criteria

YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Proven experience as a reporter in a fast-paced newsroom environment. Experience covering breaking news and working effectively under pressure to tight deadlines.Strong understanding of Scottish politics, including the work of the Scottish Government, Scottish Parliament, local government and the wider UK political landscape.Strong interviewing skills, with the confidence to question politicians, officials and stakeholders at all levels.Ability to create compelling content across multiple platforms, including text, video, audio and social media. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Gaelic.Willingness to travel and work flexibly as political events require. Ability to make complex political issues accessible and relevant to diverse audiences.

Air a Mhiannachadh

Comas dearbhte air sgeulachdan poilitigeach ùr aig a bheil buaidh a chomharrachadh, a leasachadh agus a lìbhrigeadh.Comas dearbhte air lìonra de luchd-eòlais poilitigeach a chruinneachadh agus a leudachadh.Eòlas air a bhith a’ filmeadh, a’ clàradh agus a’ deasachadh susbaint airson àrd-ùrlaran didseatach.Tuigse air mion-sgrùdadh agus dàta mun luchd-cleachdaidh gus cho-dhùnaidhean deasachaidh a stiùireadh.

Desirable

Demonstrable ability to identify, develop and deliver original political stories that have public impact.Proven ability to cultivate and maintain a network of political contacts and sources.Experience filming, recording and editing content for digital platforms.Understanding of analytics and audience data to inform editorial decision-making.

Disclaimer

This job description is a written statement of the essential characteristics of the job, with its principal accountabilities, incorporating a note of the skills, knowledge and experience required for a satisfactory level of performance. This is not intended to be a complete, detailed account of all aspects of the duties involved.

Please note: If you were to be offered this role, the BBC will conduct Employment screening checks which include Reference checks; Eligibility to work checks; and if applicable to the role, Safeguarding and Adverse media/Social media checks. Any offer made is conditional on these checks being satisfactory.

Before your start date, you may need to disclose any unspent convictions or police charges, in line with our Recruitment policy. This allows us to discuss any support you may need and assess any risks. Failure to disclose may result in the withdrawal of your offer.

For any general queries, please contact: bbchr@bbc.co.uk

We are unable to accept applications via CV and only applications made online will be considered. Please click on the APPLY NOW button to proceed with your application.

Redeployment

The BBC is committed to redeploying employees seeking suitable alternative employment within the BBC and they will be given priority consideration ahead of other applicants. Priority consideration means for those employees seeking redeployment their application will be considered alongside anyone else at risk of redundancy, prior to any individuals being considered who are not at risk.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
rows.descriptionText:
Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  What does the team work on?At Roku, the UI team builds the foundational frameworks, tooling, and high-performance UI components that power experiences across millions of devices. We own the middleware and UI layers that enable smooth navigation, responsive interactions, rich animations, and consistent developer workflows across the platform.Our work spans graphics rendering, layout and animation systems, performance optimization, and developer APIs that make it easy to create reliable, visually compelling applications at scale. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment and partner closely with firmware, platform, and product teams to ensure the end-to-end experience is fast, robust, and future-ready. What is the role?As a Senior Software Engineer on the UI team, you'll design, implement, and optimize systems that underpin Roku's user experience and developer platform. You'll work on performance-critical code paths across graphics rendering, animation, layout, and UI frameworks, ensuring smooth visuals and highly responsive interactions across a wide range of devices.At Roku, AI agents do most of the keystroke-level coding. Engineers act as the technical leads for those agents — setting context, planning work, verifying outputs, and recovering when the agent goes off course. You'll play a key role in shaping core architecture, working across the stack with hardware, firmware, and application teams, and delivering solutions that directly impact tens of millions of users. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy deep technical problem-solving, care about performance at a systems level, want to build the foundational layers that power great user experiences — and are energized by the shift to agentic engineering. If you are excited about working this way, we want to talk to you. How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. What are the responsibilities of the role?Build and scale UI frameworks and features optimized for millions of usersDesign and implement performance-critical systems across rendering pipelines, layout engines, and animation frameworks using C++Drive work through agentic coding tools — setting context, planning, and verifying agent-generated output across the full SDLCDevelop and maintain developer-facing tools and UI layersLead technical investigations and architect solutions across middleware and UI infrastructureIntegrate AI/ML and generative AI capabilities into developer workflows and platform featuresEstablish verification practices — testing, review, and quality gates — that let the team operate confidently on AI-assisted workCollaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver platform features with measurable gains in performance, reliability, and scalabilityCreate tooling, frameworks, and automation that improve developer efficiency and code qualityMentor junior engineers through design reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance — including how to effectively drive and verify AI agentsStay current with advancements in graphics, UI systems, and AI, and proactively identify opportunities for improvement What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?6+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on UI frameworks, systems, or application developmentStrong proficiency in C++ for performance-critical systems and rendering pipelinesStrong proficiency in TypeScript for building UI layers and developer-facing toolingExperience with JavaScript/BrightScript or similar scripting languagesProficiency in Python for tooling, automation, or AI workflowsDemonstrated fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks — with projects where you've shipped real work using these toolsThe ability to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping youA working understanding of common AI failure modes and the habits to catch them before they shipHands-on experience integrating AI/ML and generative AI tools into development workflows or product featuresSolid understanding of graphics systems, rendering, or UI performance optimizationStrong debugging and root cause analysis skillsClear and effective technical communication skillsYou can describe specific examples where you used AI tools, agents, or workflow automation to move faster, raise quality, or scale your impact. You frame problems well, guide AI-assisted work, verify results, and ramp quickly in unfamiliar domainsAbove all: curiosity, adaptability, good judgment, and a genuine willingness to learn new ways of working alongside AI   What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

rows.title: Digital Journalist Scheme
rows.descriptionText:
The digital journalist scheme is an exciting new programme that supports the development of journalists who wish to gain skills across video, audio, pictures, text, social or audience at the Guardian.
This programme combines practical experience, structured Guardian-designed journalism training and the completion of an apprenticeship.
Alongside hands-on newsroom experience, you’ll spend at least 20% of your time training. This will include the completion of a content creator apprenticeship, delivered in partnership with a leading training provider, and Guardian-designed training that builds on our journalistic expertise, knowledge and standards.
This is a development opportunity aimed at candidates with at least 2-3 years of experience in either video, audio, pictures, text, social or audience content. Please note: you only need experience in one area, as this role will include significant training.aWe will also be pleased to hear from candidates with more experience but please be aware this scheme is not designed for applicants with no experience in at least one of the above specialisms.
About the schemeBased in our London office, you’ll be placed in the heart of the Guardian’s newsroom, balancing hands-on content creation - from initial research to final production - with experience gained across varied editorial departments. By collaborating across different desks and experimenting with a wide range of formats, including audio, video and pictures, you’ll develop the versatility, technical expertise and adaptability required to excel in today’s digital media landscape.
Throughout the programme, you’ll actively engage in masterclasses and mentorship. Through our collaborative culture you’ll build strong cross-team relationships, contributing your unique perspective, and demonstrating the flexibility to adapt across diverse editorial disciplines.This scheme is focused on finding journalists who are looking to develop multi-platform technical skills across audio, video, photography, text, and audience engagement. If this sounds like you, we’d love to read your application.
The salary for these positions is £48,000, and the opportunities are offered on 18-month fixed-term contracts.
What you’ll gainBy the end of the programme, participants should have:Substantial practical experience within a leading newsroomExperience across a number of different editorial desksBroader skills across multiple forms of digital journalismThe confidence to take the initiative and bring new ideas and approaches to lifeA strong network of journalist colleagues and mentorsStructured feedback and professional developmentA recognised Level 3 content creator apprenticeship qualificationA clearer understanding of where your strengths and interests lie
Essential criteriaThis scheme is intended for those who have already started building relevant experience, and can demonstrate at least 2-3 years proven experience in journalism, media or content creation.
That experience could have been gained in many different ways. For example, candidates may have:Worked in journalism, publishing, digital media, audio, video or content creationWorked for a local or regional publicationUndertaken freelance journalism or media workContributed to community or independent mediaDeveloped a portfolio of journalism or content through other routes e.g. Substack.
A degree is not required, and there is no single route into the programme. We are interested in hearing from people committed to building a varied skillset.
To be eligible for the scheme, you must also have a GCSE in Maths and English at grade C/grade 4 or above - or Functional Skills equivalent, Level 2. 
Skills and attributesWe're looking for people who can demonstrate:A genuine interest in journalism and current affairsProven experience in journalism, media, or content creationStrong written and verbal communication skillsAn instinct for storytelling and curiosity to research information quicklyUnderstanding of audience needs and behaviours across platformsComfortable engaging with analytics to take a data-informed approach to decision-makingGood judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to ethical standardsConfidence contributing ideas and a strong motivation to succeedCommitment to the Guardian's editorial values and purpose.
To apply We’re proud to be partnering with Creative Access who are managing applications to the scheme.Please follow this link if your experience is largely within multimedia (video, audio, pictures), or this link if your experience falls more in text, copywriting, digital or audience (including social, newsletters, or SEO). Creative Access will use this information to make sure, if you’re successful in your application, that you’re invited to the assessment centre most relevant to your skills and experience. You’ll find details on how to apply within the links provided.
We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

We are seeking a data scientist builder to join the Audible economics team. Our group of economists, data scientists, and analysts tackles a wide range of questions, including pricing, experimentation science, data-driven product strategy/optimizations, internal productivity/incentives, audience science, and impact/ROI measurement. The ideal candidate will enjoy wearing many hats, possess an economist's mindset and a strong ability to effectively translate business questions into tractable quantitative frameworks, and excel at leveraging AI to build and scale robust, interpretable, and production-ready models/systems/tools. We're looking for someone who automates the repetitive, builds tools that force-multiply the team's output/influence, and treats AI as a core part of their workflow - not a side project. If you are passionate about leveraging data to shape the future of digital media, we encourage you to apply and be a part of our dynamic team.

As a Data Scientist, you will...

 Collaborate with economists, analysts, and other data scientists to build and scale econometric/ML models and quantitative tools - owning end-to-end scoping, data pipelining, feature engineering, model development/refinement, production-grade deployment, impact measurement, and adoption Research and evaluate emerging tools and techniques (AI-driven and otherwise), and identify novel data sources to leverage in quantitative work – both from within Audible/Amazon and from 3P sources Collaborate closely with Product, Content, and Marketing partners to drive broad impact and ensure that solutions are integrated into cross-functional workflows and executive decision-making Represent the team in a range of settings - from reviews with senior Amazon scientists to reviews with senior Audible/Amazon business leaders Mentor junior scientists and raise the bar for a new generation of scalable, AI-enabled science/analytical work, both within Audible and across the broader Amazon community

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Key job responsibilities

Basic Qualifications

 Master's degree or above in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science, or PhD 2+ years hands-on work experience in an applied/industry setting using Python and SQL to work efficiently at scale with large data sets, constructing empirical analysis, modeling, and compelling data visualizations Experience formulating and solving loosely-defined optimization and/or measurement problems Familiarity with economic methods/reasoning - causal thinking, incentive design, counterfactual frameworks - and an eagerness to continue to learn new econometric methodologies Intellectual curiosity for what drives customer value and business outcomes Comfort leading ambiguous projects from zero-to-one

Preferred Qualifications

 Fluency in mathematical foundations of statistics, machine learning, and economics Experience applying econometric methods at scale (structural modeling, observational causal inference techniques, etc.) to inform pricing/sales optimizations, investment decisions, experimentation science, and/or product optimizations in the digital media space Experience with model monitoring, debugging, and long-term maintenance in production environments Familiarity with financial/accounting metrics/methods

rows.title: Systems Operations Associate
rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  What does the team work on?Platform Operations is a department focused on VOD and Live content ingestion as well as the automated onboarding and payouts of the Content Partners themselves. This content is inclusive of first party on demand and live streaming content, as well as deep links out to third party content partner services. There are multiple departments supporting different aspects of this workflow, but ultimately everyone is dedicated to ensuring content and partners are flowing through our infrastructure pipeline and that all content is playing back properly for end users. The department facilitates the systems architecture, infrastructure, tooling and business processes for the delivery and maintenance of content with a core focus on optimal user experience and monetization. What is the role?The Systems Operations Associate facilitates the delivery of scalable process and product enhancements to Roku's content pipeline on behalf of key business stakeholders focused on business operations and service components. This role ladders up to the Platform Business & Revenue Operations group, which drives the vision, alignment, and execution of cross-functional workflows, tooling, and infrastructure needs for the content platform. The individual contributor serves as a subject matter expert of Roku's technology and business solutions owned and leveraged by the business operations department, supporting all aspects of change management related to feature releases and new process changes in partnership with business stakeholders. The Systems Operations Associate acts as the core liaison between business stakeholders and Roku's product and engineering teams, combining both technical and business functions that require strong organizational and communication skills. This fast-paced environment requires the ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision, and success depends on strong attention to detail, effective prioritization, and clear cross-functional communication.For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $99,000 and 108,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.  How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment. What are the responsibilities of the role?Serve as a partner to business stakeholders and technical teams, understanding their workflows to identify opportunities for improved data accuracy, consolidation, and process efficiencyOwn the accuracy and integrity of business operations data across core systems, ensuring stakeholders are working from a single, reliable source of truthSupport data governance and compliance requirements, including SOX and audit readiness, in partnership with legal, finance, and product teamsComplete quarterly gap analyses of as-is and to-be processes, translating findings into functional specifications for product and engineeringCollaborate with product and engineering leadership to design and improve in-house systems supporting business operations reporting, data consolidation, and workflow automationParticipate in sprint planning to prioritize enhancements and net-new feature requests across owned product roadmapsIdentify manual, error-prone, or duplicative workflows and drive automation initiatives that reduce risk and increase operational throughputSupport stakeholders in testing and validation of new product features, data models, and workflowsDevelop and maintain documentation and training materials to support rollouts and drive tool adoptionMaintain familiarity with upstream and downstream system integrations and assess how feature enhancements or data changes may impact business operationsSupport the maintenance of business and operational documentation in partnership with product and engineering counterparts What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?2–3 years of experience in business operations, systems operations, or a related analytical/operational roleExperience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or other CRM/ERP systemsExperience with data governance, data quality management, and SOX or similar compliance frameworksExperience supporting new product or feature launches requiring collaboration across cross-functional teamsComfort leveraging ticketing systems, reports, and dashboards (JIRA or Salesforce experience a plus)Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiencesAdvanced Excel/data analysis skills; experience with BI or data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) a plusSelf-organized with a structured, detail-oriented approach to workflows and problem-solvingBachelor's degree in business, computer science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

About This Opportunity

We're looking for a Technical BI & Reporting Lead to join the Client Experience & Data Platform within Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB).

You'll lead a globally distributed team responsible for delivering, supporting and evolving a significant portfolio of business-critical reporting and analytics solutions. Working across established services and strategic transformation initiatives, you'll provide technical leadership across Power BI, SQL and cloud-based analytics technologies, ensuring solutions remain scalable, reliable and aligned to business priorities. Lead and develop a globally distributed team of Business Intelligence engineers and analysts, fostering collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.Own and prioritise the BI & Reporting backlog, balancing business priorities, strategic change and operational delivery to maximise value.Provide technical leadership across Power BI, SQL and cloud-based reporting solutions, acting as a subject matter expert, reviewing solution designs and promoting engineering best practice, scalability and performance.Build strong relationships across business and technology teams, translating requirements into clear delivery priorities and influencing decision-making.Champion Agile ways of working, driving effective planning, prioritisation and continuous improvement across the team.

rows.title: Assistant Vice President, Compliance Quality Assurance

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Job Description

About The Role

The Assistant Vice President (AVP), Compliance Quality Assurance supports the execution of independent quality assurance reviews and compliance testing activities designed to assess the effectiveness of regulatory compliance, risk management practices, and internal controls across the organization.

The role contributes to the delivery of the annual QA plan through risk-based reviews, assessment of control design and operating effectiveness, identification of control gaps, and development of practical recommendations that support a strong and sustainable control environment.

The opportunity

The AVP partners with Compliance, Operational Risk, Legal, Operations, Human Resources, Finance, and business stakeholders to provide credible challenge, strengthen documentation, validate remediation, and promote consistent adherence to applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, and governance standards.

The role also includes responsible use of approved technology, data analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence tools to enhance testing efficiency, documentation quality, insight generation, and continuous monitoring, while maintaining appropriate data protection, confidentiality, and governance standards.

Responsibilities

What you’ll be doing

Quality Assurance and Compliance Testing

 Execute risk-based Compliance Quality Assurance reviews in accordance with the approved annual QA plan. Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls supporting regulatory, compliance, and operational risk requirements. Develop testing strategies, test scripts, sampling methodologies, and workpapers that are sufficient to support review conclusions. Assess compliance with applicable laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, internal policies, procedures, and standards. Identify control deficiencies, root causes, and emerging risk themes, and draft clear findings and remediations for management. Prepare concise, well-supported reports and summaries for stakeholders, senior management, and governance forums. Track management action plans and perform validation of remediation activities, including review of evidence and sustainability of corrective actions.

Risk and Control Management

 Provide independent challenge on the effectiveness of risk management practices, governance, oversight, monitoring, and reporting processes. Support issue validation activities and operating effectiveness assessments for remediated controls. Identify recurring themes across reviews and escalate significant control concerns through appropriate channels. Contribute to continuous improvement of QA methodology, testing standards, documentation practices, and reporting templates. Maintain audit-ready workpapers that clearly support conclusions, ratings, findings, and management action plans.

Data Analytics and Continuous Monitoring

 Use data analytics to identify trends, anomalies, outliers, and potential compliance or operational risk indicators. Support development of dashboards, metrics, and management reporting that enable risk-based prioritization and decision-making. Leverage approved reporting and visualization tools to improve insight, transparency, and stakeholder communication. Assist in building continuous monitoring approaches that support earlier identification of control weaknesses and emerging risks.

Artificial Intelligence and Innovation

 Demonstrate AI literacy and practical understanding of emerging AI technologies, including generative AI, machine learning, data quality, explainability, bias, and responsible AI principles. Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve productivity, research, documentation quality, testing efficiency, reporting, and workflow management. Critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, completeness, relevance, bias, and appropriateness before relying on them in QA deliverables. Identify opportunities to automate or streamline manual QA activities through approved AI-assisted analytics, workflow tools, and process improvements. Remain current on regulatory, industry, and internal expectations relating to AI governance, responsible AI usage, and technology-driven risk management.

Stakeholder Management and Communication

 Build effective relationships with Compliance, Operational Risk, Legal, Audit, Operations, HR, Finance, and business stakeholders. Facilitate constructive discussions regarding findings, recommendations, root causes, and remediation plans. Provide credible challenge in a collaborative, solutions-oriented, and non-accusatory manner. Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, external reviews, and management reporting requests as required.

Qualifications

Why Lloyds

Lloyds North America forms an integral part of Lloyds Banking Group, a leading UK‑based financial services group focused primarily on retail and commercial customer. We have operated in North America for over 100 years, delivering a client‑focused approach to large Corporate and Institutional clients with strong links to the UK.

From our New York office, we provide a comprehensive range of core banking products, including lending, trade finance, and working capital solutions, alongside debt capital and financial markets services through our U.S. broker‑dealer, Lloyds Securities Inc.

Our commitment to inclusion

At Lloyds, diversity and inclusion are core to who we are. We are committed to attracting, retaining, and developing the best talent and creating a culture where every colleague feels included, valued, and empowered to be their best.

Lloyds values diversity across all backgrounds and experiences and encourages our colleagues to bring their whole self to work. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees in accordance with applicable law.

Reasonable Accommodations for Qualified Individuals with Disabilities During the Application Process

Lloyds North America is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application process, our scheduling team can assist if you are selected to interview.

Our Benefits

We also offer a wide‑ranging benefits package, which includes:

Comprehensive health coverage with multiple medical plan options, including an HSA‑eligible plan with company contributions, plus dental, vision, and 24/7 virtual careStrong financial benefits including a 401(k) with company match and discretionary contribution, company‑paid life insurance, and short‑ and long‑term disability coverageFamily and life support such as paid family leave, backup child and elder care, employee assistance programs, and identity theft protectionWellness and lifestyle benefits including fitness programs, gym reimbursement options, pet insurance, and group legal services Ongoing training, development, mentoring, and networking opportunities Opportunities to give back through volunteering and fundraising initiatives

This is a once in a career opportunity to help shape your future as well as ours. Join us and grow with purpose.

This is a senior, high‑impact architecture role shaping the future of Investment Banking technology. The successful candidate will define the target architecture for a complex, global domain and influence decisions at CIO‑level while working hands‑on with engineering teams to resolve the most challenging architectural problems. The scope includes front‑to‑back capability simplification, data and integration strategy, platform modernisation, and the pragmatic application of AI and advanced analytics within a major financial institution.

This Role Will Appeal To Architects Who Want To


 Own the end‑to‑end domain architecture for a large, globally significant Investment Banking business. Set strategic direction and influence CIO‑level decisions on technology investment and simplification. Work directly with senior engineers and product teams to solve complex delivery challenges. Introduce and embed AI, analytics and intelligent automation in a controlled, enterprise‑grade way. Lead architectural maturity, shape standards and uplift capability across the Investment Banking domain.

rows.descriptionText:

The Opportunity

Join the FICC Analytics Convergence Quants team and help bring convergence across historically fragmented analytics in FICC. This role focuses on building and deploying a unified quant library interface and partnering on business-facing adoption across FICC. You’ll also help unify product data, market data and static data to enable shared, consistent analytics. The work spans quant library logic and internal architecture as well as performance and telemetry. Success looks like a robust shared interface that scales across asset classes with clear adoption outcomes for front office users.

Front office quantitative development experience developing and integrating models within a front office environmentApply knowledge of standard pricing models used in the investment banking industryDemonstrate strong C++ development experience including modern tooling such as Visual Studio 2019 or laterUse software engineering fundamentals across data structures, algorithms testing debugging and distributed systemsWork effectively across Windows and Linux environments with strong source control practices such as gitUse build systems such as CMake ninja and MS buildApply quant fundamentals across products market data pricing models and risk measuresSpecify implement delegate and verify software development tasks across a delivery backlogUse messaging and integration patterns such as protobuf where appropriatePython or Java experience

Converging FICC Quant Analytics

If you want your work to help simplify and scale analytics across FICC this role offers a clear platform to do it. You’ll build shared interfaces and reusable libraries that support consistent model adoption across asset classes. The scope spans architecture data unification and performance so your output will be visible in both engineering quality and front office outcomes. If this sounds like the kind of impact you want to have we’d welcome your application.

Opening up a world of opportunity.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age. rows.title: Partner Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber's delivery ecosystem is powered by deep technical integrations with an ever-growing network of external partners. As a Portfolio Partner Engineer, you'll be embedded in the restaurant tech ecosystem-working with POS, middleware, ordering, and operational platforms-to help partners build on Uber's platform and scale reliably. You'll operate in an embedded model: equal parts architecture + hands-on execution, with outsized impact on integration speed, quality, and day-2 reliability.

What The Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points

 What the Candidate Will DoOwn technical delivery for a set of restaurant tech partners: scope, design, build, launch, and operate integrations end-to-end. Collaborate with partner engineers to implement Uber APIs/webhooks correctly and drive launch readiness (testing, rollback plans, monitoring). Build durable integration patterns (templates, libraries, runbooks) to reduce one-off work and accelerate future launches. Triage and resolve complex production issues across partner + Uber systems; improve observability and prevent repeat incidents. Partner tightly with the UK-based Restaurant Tech Partner Engineering Lead and cross-functional stakeholders across EMEA (Product/Platform/BD/Ops) to translate ecosystem needs into clear technical plans.  Basic QualificationsHands-on engineering experience shipping production integrations (APIs, webhooks/events, SDKs, distributed systems) and strong debugging/troubleshooting ability. Proficiency in at least one modern language (Python, Java, Go, Node.js) with the ability to write and review production-quality code. Experience working directly with external technical stakeholders (partners/customers) to deliver implementations through ambiguity (technical scoping, timelines, launch readiness).  Preferred QualificationsExperience with restaurant technology (POS, KDS/OMS, menu/catalog sync, payment flows, delivery aggregation/middleware) or adjacent commerce ecosystems. Strong systems instincts around reliability, observability, and scale (idempotency, retries, rate limits, monitoring, incident response). Data fluency: SQL + analytics to diagnose integration health and drive prioritization (failure taxonomy, SLA/SLO thinking). Track record building reusable integration assets (reference implementations, test harnesses, partner onboarding docs, automation/tooling). 

~~ ~~

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

rows.title: Senior Product Manager - Grocery Fulfillment Optimization.
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber Grocery & Retail is scaling into a daily-use, trust-based delivery platform. Fulfillment Optimization is at the center of that ambition.

As Senior Product Manager, Grocery Fulfillment Optimization, you will own the systems and decision logic that determine last-mile order fulfillment and how reliably, efficiently, and cost-effectively it happens when conditions are imperfect.

This role sits at the intersection of marketplace algorithms, real-world logistics, and customer trust. You will work deeply with Marketplace and Data Science to design matching, batching, and recovery systems that adapt dynamically to supply, demand, store readiness, and inevitable failure modes, without degrading the customer or earner experience.

The work spans both physical-world execution (stores, couriers, timing, constraints) and abstract optimization (matching, batching, objective functions, cost-per-trip). The outcome directly impacts reliability, unit economics, and long-term platform credibility.

This is a senior IC role. We expect you to own ambiguous, cross-cutting problem spaces end-to-end, set direction for modeling and experimentation across teams, and influence roadmaps and prioritization well beyond your immediate scope.

What The Candidate Will Do

You'll tackle some of Uber's most complex fulfillment problems, where software decisions meet the realities of grocery stores, couriers, and time-bound customer expectations. In this role, you will:

 Own the decision logic behind grocery fulfillment: how orders are matched, batched, planned, recovered, and completed when real-world conditions change.  Partner closely with Marketplace and Data Science to define matching, batching, and assignment logic that balances reliability, cost-per-trip, earner experience, and store readiness, making tradeoffs explicit and testable in code, not debated in meetings.  Design resilient fulfillment systems that treat recovery and graceful degradation as core product surfaces. Build backup fulfillment paths, partial-fulfillment recovery, and risk-based reassignment that materially reduce cancellations, missed deliveries, and partial fulfillment.  Translate operational complexity into product and modeling requirements, ensuring systems behave predictably across edge cases, degraded states, and at scale.  Shift fulfillment from reactive to proactive - build systems that anticipate risk (scheduled orders, supply variability, store performance) and adapt before customers feel the impact.  Set direction for modeling and experimentation, influencing the roadmaps of partner teams (Matching, Pricing & Incentives, Ops Tech) to move the system as a whole. 

This role offers a rare opportunity to work simultaneously on logistics systems and optimization models, with direct influence on customer trust and business performance.

Basic Qualifications

 7+ years of product management experience delivering successful, durable products, with clear ownership and outcomes you can point to. Your fingerprints are all over what shipped, what scaled, and what materially improved the business.  Strong technical and operational fluency. You've built complex systems directly or worked close enough to real-world operations - last mile supply chain and logistics networks - to understand how theory breaks in practice. You can reason comfortably from high-level system design (distributed systems, event-driven architectures, APIs) down to edge cases, data flows, and how software behaves under real operational constraints and failure modes.  Experience building algorithmic or ML-adjacent products in close partnership with Data Science. You understand how objective functions, constraints, experimentation, and model tradeoffs translate into real marketplace and fulfillment outcomes.  Hands-on data fluency. You get the data you need on your own - SQL, dashboards, instrumentation - and turn it into insight that drives decisions, not analysis paralysis.  Exceptional attention to detail. You obsess over how systems behave in the real world across customers, earners, merchants, and operations, and you notice the gaps, edge cases, and failure modes others miss.  Customer obsession. You take on messy, high-stakes problems and find elegant, simple solutions so customers and partners don't have to carry platform complexity.  A strong driver mindset. You are biased toward action, a great collaborator, a master disambiguator and simplifier, and relentless about pushing work to clarity and delivery.  Sound judgment under ambiguity. You can reason through multi-sided tradeoffs - reliability, cost, customer experience, earner experience, and merchant outcomes - and make principled decisions with imperfect information.  Influence without authority. You move multiple teams in the same direction by setting clear strategy, raising the bar on quality, and earning trust through judgment and execution.  A consistently high bar. For your own contributions and for the products you ship.  A never-ending desire to learn and grow. You seek feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously sharpen your craft. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Direct grocery, last-mile, or supply chain fulfillment experience at scale. Dispatch, matching, routing, picking, or sortation systems in production, ideally with both system ownership and operations-side exposure.  Ownership of decision systems, not just diagnostic or detection tooling, the logic that decides what the system actually does when the plan breaks.  Experience launching products side-by-side with Data Science on optimization models: co-designing objective functions, constraints, and experimentation strategy.  Experience building products from 0→1 in ambiguous problem spaces, especially in marketplaces or multi-sided platforms.  Experience in grocery, retail, CPG, or e-commerce, especially where physical-world execution and software optimization intersect. 

~~ ~~

The Security Engineering team at Uber is focused on making the production and corporate environments secure by default to provide industry-leading solutions for Uber's production services and infrastructure. It provides our workforce and trusted partners a full stack identity and access management platform across a multi-cloud and hybrid SaaS environment. Our principal is secure by default with least privilege that enables business efficiency and productivity.

About The Team

Core Security Engineering's mission is to make the Uber production environment secure by default and provide industry leading products and services to all Uber's production services and infrastructure. We are focused on building both security primitives and end users products that help Uber engineers to secure their service, build trust, and advance security to enable our global business.

We are responsible for providing and managing systems, services, and libraries to provide access management, and enforcement at scale. The scope spans across multiple verticals like service-to-service authentication/authorization, employee to system auth, customer auth.

You'll work on critical distributed multi-cloud services at a massive scale crafted with the best security practices at the forefront. You'll be accountable for long term decisions on leveraging next generation infrastructure to continuously scale and operate such foundational security services.

Be intentional about leveraging AI/ML to shift-left security.  Spearhead strategic cybersecurity projects. Conduct Proofs of Concept (POCs) to evaluate and implement emerging security solutions.  Work closely with leadership to prioritize and manage engineering roadmaps.  Partner with technology, business and compliance teams to ensure cybersecurity solutions support strategic objectives and regulatory requirements.  Build, lead, and develop high-performing security engineering and architecture teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning and innovation. Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, tools, and best practices  Deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, system design, and architecture. As a member of Uber's Offensive Security team, you will work across multiple security disciplines to proactively identify and reduce risk in Uber's most critical services and emerging technologies. rows.descriptionText:
Summary

Yelp engineering culture is driven by our values: we’re a cooperative team that values individual authenticity and encourages creative solutions to problems. All new engineers deploy working code their first week, and we strive to broaden individual impact with support from managers, mentors, and teams. At the end of the day, we’re all about helping our users, growing as engineers, and having fun in a collaborative environment.

Yelp’s mission of connecting people with great local businesses requires the use of cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to scale across a vast and diverse base of users and businesses spanning various geographical locations. As a Staff-level ML Engineer on the Content Contributor Intelligence team, you will help build connections across millions of users and business listings. Your work will involve using cutting-edge industry tools, including neural networks (NNs), large language models (LLMs), and various embedding techniques for text, images, and videos. Additionally, you will apply traditional ML methods such as XGBoost and linear models to enhance our systems. You’ll be responsible for turning raw data into valuable signals and building ML systems end-to-end. This includes the full ML lifecycle from training models to deploying them in production, as well as contributing to the ML platforms these models rely on.

This opportunity is hybrid and does not require you to be located in any particular state within the US. We welcome applicants from throughout the US. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

What You'll Do

Conduct end-to-end analyses, wrangling data via SQL or Python, to statistical modeling, to hypothesizing and presenting business ideas.Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and technical excellence.Work with large and complex textual and visual datasets.Support the development and deployment of projects involving machine learned models for offline, batch-based data products as well as models deployed to online, real-time services.Work in the contributor and visual intelligence team on text and visual understanding, along with fine tuning transformer models to derive embeddings for multiple input typesProductionize and automate model pipelines within Python services.Drive and advocate adoption of best practices in ML development and operations, and mentor newer engineers in those practices.

What It Takes To Succeed

Experience developing and productionizing machine learning models, particularly in neural networks, computer vision and LLMs including their supported data pipelines.Experience with machine learning using packages such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark MLlib, XGBoost, and Sklearn.Strong coding skills in Python or equivalent (Java, C++).Solid understanding of engineering and infrastructure best practices.The curiosity to uncover promising solutions to new problems, and the persistence to carry your ideas through to an end goal.We highly value experience of working with LLMs, utilizing LLM APIs (OpenAI, Bedrock, etc), prompt engineering and evaluation.A Bachelor’s Degree or an equivalent work experience is required

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience. rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

Uber's Finance Data Platform team builds and operates the foundational data products that power Uber's financial and profitability insights. We produce trusted, reconciled, and scalable financial and performance metrics used across all of Uber's Lines of Business (LOBs) and Products.

Our datasets and metrics sit at the core of how Uber understands business performance today and plans for tomorrow: they support reporting, forecasting, profitability analyses, investment cases, and future capital allocation decisions. We partner closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Product, Data, and Operations teams to ensure stakeholders have a single source of truth for financial and profitability performance.

About The Role

As an App Developer / Data Analyst II on the Finance Data Platform team, you will use data to shape how Uber measures and understands business performance and profitability. You will own key financial and profitability metrics, build scalable reporting and analytical views, and deliver insights that directly influence strategic decisions and capital allocation across Uber.

You will act as a thought partner to Finance, Operations and Product leaders, translating complex financial and operational data into clear stories and recommendations, and helping ensure that decisions are anchored on high-quality, consistent metrics. You will also help design GenAI-powered self-serve tools that allow internal customers to get fast, intuitive answers from Finance Data Platform data and metrics.

What You'll Do

 Partner with Finance, FP&A, Accounting, Product, Operations, and Data Science teams to deeply understand how Uber measures revenue, costs, margins, and profitability across LOBs, products, and geographies.  Own and refine core financial and profitability metric definitions (e.g., revenue, variable cost, contribution margin, unit economics) and ensure they are consistently implemented and well documented across dashboards and data products.  Design, build, and maintain curated data models, views, and dashboards that provide a single source of truth for business performance analyses and financial reporting.  Design and iterate on GenAI-powered self-serve analytics tools (e.g., natural-language query interfaces, chat-based explainers) that help internal customers quickly get answers and explanations from Finance Data Platform metrics.  Analyze large-scale financial and operational datasets to identify trends, drivers, and anomalies in revenue, cost, profitability, and efficiency.  Support strategic planning and capital allocation processes by providing data-driven insights on business performance, ROI, and investment trade-offs.  Partner with Finance and Product teams to define and track KPIs for new products, features, and business initiatives, ensuring that performance is measured consistently over time.  Improve metric quality and reliability by collaborating with data engineers and finance stakeholders on data pipelines, controls, and reconciliation between financial systems and analytical datasets.  Communicate complex analyses, assumptions, and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership. 

Basic Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative and business field.  Strong proficiency in SQL, including experience working with large-scale analytical data warehouses and complex joins/transformations.  Proficiency in at least one scripting or analysis language such as Python or R for deeper analysis, automation, and data quality checks.  Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports in a modern BI tool (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) for Finance or business stakeholders.  Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems, define and operationalize metrics, and design analyses end-to-end.  Strong communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex financial and technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and drive alignment on recommendations. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience in fintech, financial services, or working closely with Finance, FP&A, or Accounting teams in a data or analytics capacity.  Clear understanding of financial concepts such as revenue recognition, cost allocation, unit economics, contribution margin, forecasting, and capital allocation.  Experience working with financial data models and reconciliations between source systems (e.g., billing, payments, ledgers, ERP) and analytical layers.  Experience supporting planning, forecasting, or performance management processes with data and metrics.  Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, prioritize among competing tasks, and drive complex, multi-stakeholder projects to completion in a fast-paced environment.

Hotel Development Strategy & Governance

Define and lead the global strategy, vision, and governance model for hotel leadership and career development across Marriott International. Establish a clear, enterprise-wide hotel leadership development ecosystem that integrates early career entry, core development, qualification, Executive Committee readiness, General Manager development, and succession into a coherent progression. Ensure priorities align with Marriott’s business strategy, brand growth, operational transformation, and leadership philosophy. Set global standards, frameworks, and success measures while enabling flexibility for continent, brand, and service-model needs. Define strategies, project plans, and business cases for investment where capability gaps are unsolved or existing solutions require evolution or retirement. 

Core Programs & Qualification Frameworks

Own the portfolio of core development programs serving on-property associates and leaders, ensuring clarity of purpose, role-based pathways, and consistent quality of experience at scale. Define and govern qualification frameworks that establish what readiness means for key hotel roles, including standards of evidence, assessment approach, certification, and the relationship between qualification and appointment decisions. Ensure qualification frameworks are defensible, operationally realistic, and consistently applied across continents while accommodating brand and market variation. Partner with continent learning teams and Operations to drive adoption, completion, and sustained application of core programs in the hotel environment. 

General Manager Development & Field Leader Enablement

Own the holistic General Manager development ecosystem — onboarding, acceleration, and continuous professional development — serving General Managers across brands, geographies, and service and operating models. Put the General Manager at the center of learning: design and own the vehicle that anchors the full General Manager learning experience — leadership, commercial, technical, and brand — into a single coherent, sequenced, and navigable experience rather than a set of unconnected demands on a General Manager’s time. Own leadership development for General Managers directly, and work through the Performance Advisory function for every other aspect of the General Manager experience, engaging Operations, Commercial, and Brand through the strategic partnerships Performance Advisory holds rather than in parallel to them. Collaborate with Performance Advisory to surface, interpret, and translate General Manager learning needs originating across Operations, Commercial, and Brand, ensuring those needs are genuinely catered to within the General Manager experience. Establish shared governance and joint prioritization with Performance Advisory across the General Manager learning agenda — covering sequencing, volume, and timing — so the experience remains coherent and realistic against the capacity of General Managers to participate. Guide the design and evolution of flagship General Manager programs and experiences, integrating diagnostics, feedback mechanisms, and experiential learning to drive sustained behavior change and performance impact. Equip the Regional Vice President community to develop, coach, and grow the General Managers they lead, providing the frameworks, tools, diagnostics, and enablement that make field leaders more effective developers of talent. Partner with Operations and HR leadership on General Manager readiness, bench strength, and leadership risk, and represent hotel development in enterprise talent and succession discussions. 

Executive Committee Development & Pathway Programs

Own leadership development for hotel Executive Committee members across disciplines, ensuring solutions build both functional leadership capability and enterprise leadership breadth. Design and govern pathway potential programs that identify, assess, and accelerate Executive Committee members with potential to progress toward General Manager and broader leadership roles. Establish nomination and selection governance for pathway programs — eligibility, calibration, cohort composition, and the relationship between participation and readiness and succession decisions. Ensure pathway programs are globally relevant and culturally nuanced, and that participant experience is used as source material rather than content delivered at delegates. 

Early Careers & Career Growth

Set the strategy for early career development, ensuring Marriott attracts, develops, and retains talent entering hospitality careers and builds a durable pipeline into hotel leadership. Oversee the portfolio of early career and career growth programs, including entry pathways, Voyage or other graduate-style programs, and the tools that help associates navigate careers across brands and disciplines. Partner with Talent Acquisition, continent teams, and external education and industry partners to connect early career programming to hiring, mobility, and retention outcomes. Ensure early career solutions connect coherently into core programs and qualification frameworks so that progression is visible and navigable for associates. 

Measurement, Insights & Business Impact

Establish and lead a measurement and insights strategy linking hotel development investments to leader effectiveness, operational results, and business outcomes. Use data and insights to evaluate program effectiveness, identify trends and gaps, and inform continuous improvement and strategic decisions. Provide enterprise-level reporting and insights to senior leadership on hotel leader capability, readiness, and development impact. 

Team & Business Management

Lead, develop, and elevate a team of five, comprising two Directors as direct reports — one accountable for the hotel leadership stream and one accountable for early careers — together with the specialists supporting each stream, ensuring clear ownership, coherent hand-offs, and a single integrated portfolio rather than two parallel ones. Accountable for work planning, team development, and people management, ensuring the team is leveraged across projects and connected into the wider Leadership Development function. Manage budgets related to hotel development programs and drive strong business and financial management practices, including vendor and partner spend. Cultivate a team culture rooted in performance, business acumen, cross-team collaboration, and insights-driven work. 

Innovation & Continuous Evolution

Stay at the forefront of global hospitality, leadership, and learning trends to continuously evolve Marriott’s approach to hotel development. Drive innovation through experimentation, external benchmarking, and partnerships with leading institutions and vendors, considering technology and automation to drive efficiency and scale. Champion a culture of continuous learning, growth, and leadership excellence across the hotel community. 

Critical Skills

Enterprise Strategic Leadership: Anticipates future hotel capability needs and aligns development strategy with long-term business priorities. Operational & Commercial Acumen: Solid understanding of hotel operations, owner dynamics, and performance drivers; credible with operators. Systems Thinking: Designs an integrated development progression from early career to General Manager rather than a collection of standalone programs. Curation & Prioritization: Works with partner functions to judge what earns a place in a leader’s limited learning time, sequencing and editing competing priorities into one coherent experience. Executive Presence & Influence: Builds credibility and alignment with senior leaders; shapes decisions and mobilizes action without direct authority. People Leadership: Sets direction, develops Directors, and holds a coherent portfolio together across two distinct streams. Global Collaboration & Contracting: Establishes clear contracting, roles, and decision rights across interdependent functions; leads effectively across cultures, geographies, brands, and complex matrix environments. Data-Driven Decision Making: Uses insights and analytics to demonstrate impact, guide strategy, and defend investment. 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.
