rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

eBay’s Compliance team is building a strong, innovative Anti-Money Laundering / Counter Terrorist Financing (AML/CTF) program that supports trust, safety, and regulatory excellence across our marketplace ecosystem. This team plays a meaningful role in strengthening transaction monitoring capabilities for eBay, Depop, and other subsidiaries, while helping build a culture of compliance through data-driven insights and scalable controls.

The AML Transaction Monitoring Specialist will be a foundational contributor to the Transaction Monitoring Program, partnering across AML Compliance, Engineering, Risk, Product, Customer Experience, Finance, Legal, and Operations. In this role, you will help build, improve, and maintain monitoring rules, analytics, reporting, and system controls that detect potential money laundering and terrorist financing activity. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working with large datasets, solving sophisticated problems, and shaping high-impact compliance solutions in a fast-moving, global environment.

What You Will Accomplish

Analyze large, sophisticated datasets to identify trends, patterns, and typologies related to potential money laundering or terrorist financing activity, and translate insights into clear reporting for leadership.Design, test, implement, and maintain transaction monitoring rules, scenarios, and supporting analytics that strengthen AML program coverage across eBay, Depop, and other subsidiaries.Build and enhance KPI dashboards, standardized reporting packages, and ad hoc analyses that help measure program effectiveness and support timely business and compliance decisions.Partner cross-functionally with Compliance, Engineering, Risk, Product, Operations, and other stakeholders to define business requirements and deliver scalable monitoring and control solutions.Improve data architecture, mapping, ingestion, and automation to support efficient monitoring processes, strong data quality, and sustainable operational controls.Support high-priority compliance data and technology initiatives, contributing to system improvements, risk mitigation strategies, and the continued evolution of a best-in-class transaction monitoring program.


What You Will Bring

Must reside in the Austin metro area and be able to work onsite in our Austin office 3 or more days per week.2–4 years of experience working with large datasets and writing complex queries across multiple data sources, with hands-on skills in Python, SQL, and data analysis in a compliance, risk, or technology environment.2–4 years of experience in transaction monitoring, AML typologies, financial crime risk, or related compliance disciplines, with the ability to help develop effective monitoring coverage and risk-based rules.2–4 years of experience with data warehousing, big data environments such as Hadoop, and business intelligence tools such as Tableau; advanced Excel skills are a plus.2–4 years of experience in statistical modeling, data mapping, reporting automation, and translating analytical findings into practical business or compliance solutions.Strong communication, documentation, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain insights and recommendations clearly to partners and leaders across functions.


Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$85,000-$105,000

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guidelines.

rows.title: Senior Analyst, Loyalty Marketing
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

At Williams-Sonoma, Inc. our mission is to enhance people’s lives at home. This mission inspires and drives us, informs our strategy, as well as makes us special. The Loyalty Team supports that mission by leading The Key Rewards, our cross-brand loyalty and credit card programs. Covering beloved brands (including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Mark & Graham, and Rejuvenation) our innovative team powers strategy, marketing, analytics, and operations to build loyalty across every customer touchpoint.

About The Role

The Senior Analyst, Loyalty Marketing will play a critical role in developing, executing, and optimizing initiatives that drive customer loyalty and elevate the customer experience across the Williams-Sonoma, Inc. family of brands.

This role will support the planning and execution of performance marketing strategies for The Key Rewards, WSI’s loyalty and credit card program, with the goal of driving member engagement, card acquisition, customer spend, and cross-brand shopping behavior across stores and eCommerce. The Senior Analyst will work closely with internal cross-functional teams, brand partners, Capital One, and other third parties to develop marketing campaigns and customer journeys that support Loyalty KPIs.

A successful candidate will have strong marketing, analytical, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, translate data into actionable insights, and build strong relationships across teams. This is an exciting and evolving role with visibility across many areas of the organization.

Responsibilities


Own and manage loyalty marketing campaigns across email, digital, print, stores, site placements, and other channels, including campaign briefs, timelines, approvals, execution, and post-campaign analysis. Maintain and evolve the loyalty marketing calendar, partnering with brand teams to bring cross-brand and loyalty messages to life. Partner with internal stakeholders, Capital One, and third-party vendors to develop online and offline campaigns that support program objectives. Use web, email, and customer analytics to improve campaign performance and customer experience. Collaborate with internal and external partners to define target audiences, refresh creative, optimize placements, and improve campaign effectiveness. Support personalization strategy by helping deliver relevant loyalty and credit card messages across the right channels and moments in the customer journey. Develop and manage project plans, including timelines, milestones, issue tracking, and cross-functional follow-ups. Track competitive, consumer, and loyalty marketing trends to inform roadmap opportunities and new test ideas. Support marketing budget management, including invoicing, accruals, forecasts, and vendor coordination. Contribute to ad hoc marketing, analytics, and strategic projects that support Loyalty team priorities. 


Criteria


Minimum of 2-4 years in performance marketing; retail or loyalty experience preferred. Strong critical thinking skills, with the ability to translate data and trends into actionable recommendations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for different audiences. Strong analytical skills and high attention to detail. Strong organization and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, timelines, stakeholders, and vendors at once. Ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Comfortable working cross-functionally and building relationships with internal and external partners. Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field. Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with data Visualization tools (i.e., Domo, Tableau, Adobe Analytics). Budgeting, invoicing, or vendor management experience preferred. 


Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


A generous discount on all WSI brandsA 401(k) plan and other investment opportunitiesPaid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteerHealth benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefitsTax-free commuter benefitsA wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


Continued Learning


In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI UniversityCross-brand and cross-function career opportunities Resources for self-developmentAdvisor (Mentor) programCareer development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

The expected starting pay range for this position is $78,000- $92,000. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

rows.title: Senior Analyst, Planning & Forecasting
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DESCRIPTION 

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in Dallas, TX or Remote

This is your opportunity to be part of a Customer Care Team that is revolutionizing human hospitality in a digital world. As a Senior Analyst Capacity Planning and Forecasting, you hold primary accountability for the headcount and hiring strategies that power Hilton Reservation and Customer Care contact centers globally. Unlike a traditional analyst role, you will focus on strategically balancing exceptional guest experiences, service level performance, and global cost optimization. You will use advanced business intelligence and predictive modeling to mitigate operational risk and lead long-term planning decisions.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Forecasting, Planning and Analytics, you serve as the strategic consultant to our Partner Managers and external service providers. You lead the roadmap that brings global hiring decisions to life, distilling complex data into executive-level insights and owning global initiatives from concept through delivery.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day:

Lead recurring Workforce Management calls with external partners to synchronize on contact volume trends, performance gaps, and execution of staffing strategies.Build optimized headcount and hiring plans by managing customer experience, service levels, and global cost efficiencies.Be the primary contact for communicating hiring plan adjustments and staffing changes to Partner Managers to ensure seamless contact center coverage.Maintain advanced staffing models using Python to create predictive targets for headcount and hiring needs.Analyze contact flows and track staffing accuracy to measure operational efficiency across internal and external partner teams.Use tools like MicroStrategy, Alteryx, and Power BI to query the Enterprise Data Warehouse and build automated reports to identify trends and discover root causes of results.Translate complex forecast and capacity outputs into clear, data-driven operational guidance for business owners.

How You'll Collaborate With Others:

Engage with Partner Managers and external vendors to align on headcount requirements and contact volume support.Translate staffing model outputs and operational variances into clear, actionable executive summaries for global leadership.Collaborate with Workforce Management, Operations, and Engineering teams to operationalize hiring plans.Work across teams and functions, embracing diverse perspectives to arrive at solutions to staff and support our customers.

Projects You'll Take Ownership Of:

Lead the development of staffing and hiring plans for assigned global business units.Design complex hiring scenarios tied to growth, seasonality, and shifting operational needs.Oversee the communication and reporting workflows that bridge internal planning with external partner performance.Challenge the status quo by mastering new tools or languages to improve the capacity toolkit.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications:

Two (2) years of experience in capacity planning or modelingTwo (2) years of experience in quantitative and qualitative analysis including the use of statistical and predictive modelsFamiliarity with operational planning for medium to large organizationsHigh level of proficiency in SQL-based BI tools (e.g., MicroStrategy, Alteryx, or Power BI)Working knowledge of Python, including the skill to read, understand, and modify existing scriptsExpertise in communicating analytical findings to important partners and executives

It Would Be Useful If You Have:

Bachelor's Degree in a related quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science) or equivalent specialized experience.Two (2) years of experience in capacity planning or modeling in a contact center environmentExperience managing projects and timelines, working directly with partnersExperience using programming languages to build scripts such as RKnowledge of database architecture and data modeling principles and techniques

rows.title: Director, Hotel Leadership Development
rows.descriptionText:
Additional Information

Job Number26121991

Job CategoryHuman Resources

Location7750 Wisconsin Avenue, Bethesda MD 20814, United States VIEW ON MAP

ScheduleFull Time

Located Remotely?N

Position Type Management

Pay Range: $127,000-$160,000 annually

Bonus Eligible: Y

Stock Package: Y

Job Summary

The Associate Development function at Marriott International serves the learning and development needs of associates worldwide, enabling every associate’s journey to peak performance while accelerating results to Grow Forward, faster. The Director, Hotel Leadership Development is accountable for designing, building, and bringing to life the leadership development solutions that serve leaders in Marriott’s hotels — from core development through Executive Committee, General Manager, and the field leadership community that supports them.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Hotel Leadership and Career Development, this role translates enterprise strategy into working solutions. Where the Senior Director sets global direction, governance, and standards, the Director owns the architecture, design, delivery, and continuous improvement of the hotel leadership portfolio: core programs serving on-property leaders; qualification frameworks that define and certify readiness for key hotel roles; leadership development and pathway potential programs for hotel Executive Committee members; the General Manager development ecosystem spanning onboarding, acceleration, and continuous professional development; and the enablement that equips the Regional Vice President community to develop and coach the General Managers they lead.

This is a hands-on design and delivery role as well as a consultative one. The Director serves as a trusted advisor to continent learning teams, senior operational leaders, and HR partners for hotel leadership development needs; facilitates flagship experiences for senior hotel audiences; sets facilitation standards and provides guidance and support to the facilitator community owned by continent learning teams; and manages the external partners and vendors who deliver alongside Marriott.

For General Manager development specifically, the Director works within the partnership the Senior Director holds with the Performance Advisory function, which serves as the strategic thought partner to Corporate Disciplines such as Finance, Risk Management, HR and Ethics and Compliance. The Director engages those disciplines through that partnership rather than in parallel to it, ensuring the learning experience General Managers receive is coherent, well sequenced, and realistic against the demands on their time.

The Director also partners closely with the Brand Talent Associate Development team to ensure alignment between the enterprise hotel leadership portfolio and the learning and development strategy for Marriott’s luxury brands, supporting the distinct expectations, service culture, and leader capability requirements those brands carry.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

4-year degree from an accredited university in Organizational Behavior/Development, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or related major 8 years of experience in leadership development, learning and development, organizational development, and/or hospitality operations, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance 

OR

Master’s degree or MBA from an accredited university in Business Management, Adult Education, Organizational Behavior/Development, or similar 5 years of experience in leadership development, learning and development, or related professional area 

Preferred

Deep understanding of the hotel operating environment and the unique demands of the General Manager and Executive Committee roles across brands, service models, and geographies Hotel operations leadership experience, or demonstrated credibility with operations leaders earned through sustained partnership Demonstrated expertise designing, implementing, and measuring leadership development solutions at global scale Experience building or operating qualification, certification, or role-readiness frameworks Proven ability to facilitate engaging learning experiences for diverse audiences, including senior leaders Strong consultative and diagnostic skills to translate business needs into targeted development solutions Strong project and program management skills, with experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives to delivery Proven ability to influence without authority, build alignment, and drive results across a global matrix organization Experience with assessment tools, diagnostics, learning technologies, and analytics Familiarity with luxury hospitality and the distinct leader capability and service culture expectations of luxury brands Experience selecting and managing external design and delivery partners Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to engage confidently with senior leadership and external partners 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Architecture & Solution Design

Translate the hotel leadership development strategy into a clear architecture of offerings — core learning, diagnostics, assessments, experiences, and resources — aligned to enterprise leadership principles and hotel operational realities. Lead the design, build, and evolution of global leadership programs and experiences for hotel leaders, applying data, insights, and modern learning methodologies. Integrate assessment, feedback, and experiential learning into program design to drive sustained behavior change rather than content consumption. Ensure solutions are designed for scale and adaptable across continents, brands, and service and operating models without losing coherence. 

Core Programs & Qualification Frameworks

Own the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of core development programs serving on-property leaders, ensuring clarity of purpose, role-based pathways, and consistent quality of experience at scale. Build and operate qualification frameworks for key hotel roles, including standards of evidence, assessment approach, and certification mechanics, working within the governance the Senior Director establishes. Maintain the operational integrity of qualification — records, moderation, consistency of assessor judgment, and defensibility of outcomes — across continents and markets. Partner with continent learning teams and Operations to drive adoption, completion, and sustained application in the hotel environment. 

General Manager Development

Build and sustain the General Manager development ecosystem — onboarding, acceleration, and continuous professional development — serving General Managers across brands, geographies, and service and operating models. Design and deliver flagship General Manager programs and experiences, ensuring they meet the range of need from newly appointed General Managers to seasoned leaders running complex hotels. Curate and sequence the wider General Manager learning experience so that leadership, commercial, technical, and brand content arrives as one navigable whole, engaging those disciplines through the Performance Advisory partnership. Equip the Regional Vice President community with the frameworks, tools, diagnostics, and enablement that make field leaders more effective developers of the General Managers they lead. 

Executive Committee Development & Pathway Programs

Design and deliver leadership development for hotel Executive Committee members across disciplines, building both functional leadership capability and enterprise leadership breadth. Build and run pathway potential programs that identify, assess, and accelerate Executive Committee members with potential to progress toward General Manager and broader leadership roles. Operate nomination and selection processes for pathway programs — eligibility screening, calibration input, cohort composition, and participant communication — within the governance the Senior Director sets. Ensure programs are globally relevant and culturally nuanced, and that participant experience is used as source material rather than content delivered at delegates. 

Facilitation & Delivery

Facilitate flagship leadership experiences for senior hotel audiences, including General Managers and Executive Committee cohorts. Set facilitation standards, approach, and quality expectations for the hotel leadership portfolio. Provide guidance, tools, and support to the facilitator community built and owned by continent learning teams, including facilitator guides, briefing and calibration sessions, and quality feedback that helps continents deliver the portfolio consistently at scale. 

Consulting & Partnership

Serve as a trusted advisor to continent learning teams, senior operational leaders, and HR partners, translating operational challenges into practical development solutions. Influence and align diverse stakeholders to drive adoption of the hotel leadership development portfolio and sustain long-term engagement. Work within the Performance Advisory partnership for aspects of the General Manager experience outside leadership development, respecting discipline relationships and surfacing issues to the Senior Director where alignment is needed. Partner closely with the Luxury Brand Associate Development team to align the hotel leadership portfolio with the learning and development strategy for Marriott’s luxury brands, ensuring enterprise solutions accommodate luxury service culture and leader expectations, and supporting luxury-specific development where it connects to the enterprise portfolio. Navigate complex matrix environments with credibility and diplomacy across cultures, geographies, and brands. 

Program & Project Management

Own delivery roadmaps, resourcing plans, and program operations for the hotel leadership portfolio, ensuring execution excellence across regions. Manage program budgets and third-party spend, and select, brief, and manage external design and delivery partners to deliver against Marriott standards. Anticipate and mitigate risks to delivery, escalating trade-offs and decisions to the Senior Director where they affect strategy, investment, or governance. 

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Operate the measurement approach for hotel leadership development, linking learning outcomes to leader effectiveness and business impact. Monitor and assess the effectiveness of programs and qualification outcomes, and use insights to evolve offerings and retire what no longer earns its place. Stay current on global hospitality, leadership, and learning trends, and benchmark Marriott’s offerings against external best practice to drive continuous innovation. 

Critical Skills

Design & Execution: Turns strategy into a coherent architecture of offerings and gets them built, delivered, and adopted. Operational Acumen: Understands hotel dynamics and designs solutions that hold up in the operating environment and drive on-property performance. Executive Facilitation & Presence: Credible and compelling in front of senior hotel audiences; sets the standard for facilitation quality across the portfolio. Consultative Diagnosis: Diagnoses the real need beneath the stated request and recommends the proportionate solution. Influence & Storytelling: Builds relationships and mobilizes others to action through partnership, consultation, and storytelling, without relying on authority. Enterprise Collaboration: Works effectively across functions, cultures, geographies, and brands to create global alignment and local relevance. Innovation & Learning Mindset: Embraces experimentation, evidence, and continuous improvement in leadership development. 

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law. 

All positions offer a 401(k) plan, stock purchase plan, discounts at Marriott properties, commuter benefits, employee assistance plan, and childcare discounts. Benefits are subject to terms and conditions, which may include rules regarding eligibility, enrollment, waiting period, contribution, benefit limits, election changes, benefit exclusions, and others. Click here to learn more.

Full-time positions also offer coverage for medical, dental, vision, health care flexible spending account, dependent care flexible spending account, life insurance, disability insurance, accident insurance, adoption expense reimbursements, paid parental leave and educational assistance.

Washington Applicants Only: Employees will accrue paid sick leave, 0.077 PTO balance for every hour worked and be eligible to receive a minimum of 9 holidays annually.

Marriott Headquarters (HQ) supports a hybrid work environment that helps associates Be Connected. HQ based roles are generally hybrid and require regular in-office presence at the assigned location, including for candidates who live within commuting distance of HQ for a role listed as remote. Remote roles will be clearly identified in the job posting.

Marriott International is the world’s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

Job Description
Be part of an amazing story
Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.
Job Overview
The Loyalty and Personalization Specialist is a strategic project manager who brings structure, rigor, and clear execution to Macy’s loyalty and personalization initiatives. This role is well-suited for an individual eager to manage cross-functional projects from planning through delivery in a high-performance, results-driven retail environment. The Specialist is responsible for owning the team’s project roadmap, managing risk and timelines, and reporting on progress and results, while partnering across Merchandising, Marketing, and technology teams to keep initiatives on track. rows.title: Director, Creative Operations
rows.descriptionText:
At Chewy, taking care of pets and the people who love them through the highs, the lows, and the everyday is what drives us. Grounded in that purpose and focused on our mission to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents and partners everywhere, we work every day to help people feel more confident, supported, and capable in caring for the animals they love—showing up with the products, services, care, and guidance they need, whenever they need it.

Bringing that to life takes exceptional leaders.

Leadership at Chewy is guided by our Operating Principles, which define how we lead, make decisions, develop talent, serve our customers, and grow our business. We value leaders who think strategically, stay close to the customer, and aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves alongside their teams. They solve complex challenges, build high-performing organizations, and partner closely with senior leaders to shape the future of Chewy.

If you're energized by building, leading, and making a meaningful impact, this leadership opportunity may be the right fit for you.

Your Opportunity

You will lead the operations engine behind Chewy’s Marketing Creative and Production teams, driving high-impact work with clarity, precision, and efficiency. You’ll oversee the Project Management functions, high-level operations, and data analytics for the Creative and Studios organizations, including the technology, platforms, and tools that support planning and execution. Your leadership will focus on building and optimizing workflows that enable creative and production teams to deliver high-quality content at scale. As a key change agent, you will introduce and manage operational improvements with empathy, structure, and influence, ensuring smooth adoption across teams. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally to align workflows with business goals and empower teams to deliver great work on time and with purpose. Strong communications will be your key differentiator and define your success.

This role will be expected to challenge the status quo and lead the evolution of how Creative and Studios operate. Beyond managing today’s business, you will define and implement a more agile, scalable, and efficient operating model—rethinking processes, ways of working, team interactions, and enabling tools to improve speed, clarity, and creative output. You will build the operational capabilities needed for where the organization is going, not simply maintain how work gets done today.

You Will Directly Oversee

 Project Management — Owns the how and when, leading campaigns from intake through delivery. Project Managers consolidate execution under one owner, manage risk, and drive campaign delivery. They ensure all milestones, dependencies, and communications align across Creative, Studio, and Marketing. Creative & Studio Operations— Oversees strategic and operational planning, resource allocation, and performance measurement for the Creative and Studios organizations. Develop and implement processes that drive efficient and high quality work. Creative & Studio Data- Leverages data and analytics to track efficiency, capacity, and effectiveness of teams and workflows; drives insight-informed decision-making and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Do

 Define and lead the transformation roadmap for Creative and Studio operations, moving the organization from current-state ways of working toward a simpler, faster, more scalable operating model. Challenge legacy processes and operating norms, identifying where work can be eliminated, simplified, automated, or fundamentally redesigned rather than incrementally improved. Establish and embed agile or hybrid ways of working across Creative and Production, creating operating rhythms that enable teams to prioritize effectively, respond quickly to changing business needs, and accelerate work from brief through delivery. Partner with Creative and Marketing leadership to define how teams should work together, clarifying decision rights, handoffs, roles, and accountability across the end-to-end creative lifecycle. Lead the Project Management teams responsible for delivering end-to-end support for creative and production projects across marketing channels (digital, print, video, social, etc.). Oversee high-level operations and data analytics across the Creative and Studio organizations, supporting capacity planning, team performance, and operational effectiveness. Own the development, optimization, and governance of scalable creative workflows, ensuring alignment across intake, prioritization, production, review, and delivery. Oversee the strategy, implementation, and ongoing improvement of project management tools and workflow platforms (e.g., Workfront, Airtable, Asana, Smartsheet). Drive change management initiatives that modernize and elevate creative operations, ensuring that updates to processes, tools, and structures are clearly communicated, adopted, and sustained. Champion operational clarity, guiding teams through transitions with confidence and structure while reinforcing shared ownership of new processes. Collaborate with marketing, creative, production, merchandising, and analytics partners to ensure workflows support business priorities and creative excellence. Manage project intake processes and operational planning cadences to ensure resources are properly allocated and timelines are met. Build and maintain reporting frameworks and dashboards that provide actionable insights into workflow health, project status, and team capacity. Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of program and project managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence. Act as the central operational liaison across internal and external teams to ensure seamless coordination throughout the creative production lifecycle.

Proactively identify systemic operational gaps, inefficiencies, and unclear ownership across the creative lifecycle, including issues not yet fully defined. Establish the right processes, accountability, and operating mechanisms to address them and drive continuous improvement.

What You’ll Need

 10+ years of experience in Creative or Marketing Operations, Program Management, or related functions, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. Deep experience designing and managing complex workflows that support cross-functional creative and content teams inclusive of leveraging AI for efficiencies. Deep experience designing and implementing agile or hybrid creative operating models, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, workflow management, and continuous improvement. Keen understanding of organizational change management with a proven track record of successfully implementing process, platform, and cultural shifts within creative or marketing organizations. Experience overseeing operational performance and leveraging data analytics to drive insights and improve efficiency. Expertise with project and workflow management platforms (e.g., Workfront, Airtable, Asana, Smartsheet) and strong operational tool fluency inclusive of AI. Demonstrated success in implementing and scaling efficient operational processes that support creative delivery. Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to build dashboards and track KPIs to measure workflow performance. Excellent communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills across all levels and functions. Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with shifting priorities. Experience managing large project portfolios with multiple stakeholders and competing timelines. Demonstrated track record leading meaningful operating model or process transformation within a Creative, Marketing, Production, or similarly complex organization—not simply administering established processes.

Bonus

 Experience working in or managing in-house creative operations teams within a marketing or e-commerce organization. Familiarity with content lifecycle planning and performance optimization within creative workflows. Knowledge of agile or hybrid project management methodologies as applied to creative and marketing teams.

What You’ll Get

 A place where you can be your authentic self and grow your career. Our pet parents and partners are from everywhere, different places and different walks of life. It is what makes them unique. Likewise, Chewtopians are encouraged to bring their perspectives to deliver on our mission! Work in a culture that cares, with managers who value you and your career journey. Be empowered to think big, thrive on delivering results, and to become your best. Development of meaningful connections with a diverse group of Chewtopians through Team Member Resource Groups and celebrate inclusivity with various company events, programs, and activities. Comprehensive medical, dental, vision benefits, in addition to wellness programs and resources, enabling you to be your best self in and outside of work.

The base salary range for this role is $170,500 - $271,500.00.

The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations.

The Senior Manager, Marketing Measurement Analytics (MMM) is a key contributor within Marriott’s Enterprise Data, Analytics & AI organization, responsible for delivering insights that optimize marketing performance and inform strategic decision-making. Working closely with marketing leaders and cross-functional teams, the Senior Manager conducts targeted analyses, interprets complex data, and translates findings into clear, actionable recommendations. By leveraging curated data assets and advanced analytics techniques, this position ensures marketing strategies are grounded in robust insights and aligned with enterprise priorities. The Senior Manager combines strong analytical expertise with business acumen and exceptional communication skills to influence decisions and drive measurable impact—helping Marriott maximize marketing performance and return on investment.

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

The Senior Director of Workforce Strategy & Operational Excellence is a critical member of the PSC Leadership Board and serves as the executive leader accountable for the enterprise workforce strategy, organizational readiness, operational excellence, and regulatory integrity of a ~1,500-person patient-engagement organization with covered entity status. This role shapes the multi-year operating model, workforce strategy, AI transformation roadmap, and organizational capabilities necessary to support business growth, portfolio expansion, regulatory compliance and exceptional patient and provider experiences. Through enterprise-wide influence and cross-functional partnership, this leader drives organizational resilience, mitigates business risk, and enables the successful execution of Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine's evolving patient engagement strategy. Leads executive-level analytics and reporting across the PSC/ATC, including dashboards, operational scorecards, root-cause analyses, and ad-hoc requests designed to identify opportunities for improved impact and future risk mitigation.

Leads major transformation embedding AI into workflows and ensuring the workforce is prepared for the new operating modelsEstablishes metrics, assesses outcomes and drives PSC/ATC learning and development programs to ensure continuous improvement based on technology and market based evolution.

Compliance & Quality Assurance

Serves as executive leader of enterprise compliance governance and risk mitigation ensuring adherence to the numerous state and federal laws governing pharmacy operations and operations as a covered entity (HIPPA, etc)Establishes compliance processes, awareness and execution to ensure audit readiness, regulatory adherence, and protection of J&J business integrity and reputation.Accountable for interpreting audit (internal & external) findings, disseminating them to business partners and putting appropriate mitigations in place. Serves as decision maker on utilization of AI within the PSC/ATC based on enterprise standards and governmental oversight of PHI.Institutes and governs Quality Assurance frameworks, monitoring standards, calibration models, and documentation practices that meet internal & external regulatory expectations.Shape changes in workforce design, deployment, SOP’s and training using QA results to improve business impact and strengthen employee performance and accountability. 

Strategic Leadership & Innovation

Builds a high performing culture focused on talent acquisition, development and retention designed to minimize turnover and negative business impact.Owns development of the multi-year roadmap for PSC/ATC workforce and operational excellence strategy, ensuring readiness for business growth, new product launches, digital transformation, and evolving patient engagement models. Advises PSC and Innovative Medicine executives on workforce investment decisions, organizational effectiveness, capability gaps, and risk mitigation strategies.Leads cross-functional prioritization and resource allocation discussions with senior leaders across Commercial, Technology, Compliance, Finance, and Patient Engagement organizations. Assesses the market for emerging trends related to programs, technology enhancements and AI to make recommendations to PSC & PECS leadership on new ways to evolve the PSC/ATC model.

Other

 Up to 25% domestic travel. Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, operations, analytics, business or related field. A minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in enterprise functions with contact centers, specialty pharmacy, or healthcare operations (workforce management, analytics, QA, compliance).5+ years leading directors and managers overseeing centralized support services or operations excellence teams.Demonstrated success building and scaling complex forecasting models to manage human capital allocations and needsStrong knowledge of healthcare regulatory requirements and privacy standards (e.g., HIPAA) as they apply to operational support functions.Profound understanding of current and future AI applications and governance requirements in a PHI environment Proven executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders through data-driven insights and recommendations.Advanced proficiency with WFM tools, BI/reporting platforms, and data governance practices.Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills. Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock - from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news, and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify workflow efficiencies and implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products, and processes.

Our Team

The Entity team is responsible for the creation and support of core entity data, assignment of risk allocation, and corporate hierarchy research for over 7 million public and private companies. To accomplish this, the team relies on the design and implementation of data processing workflows that aim to meet our client’s timeliness, quality, and coverage needs.

The Role

As the Entities Team Leader, you will play a key role in developing and leading individuals with a diverse set of backgrounds. You will lead by example in understanding data management practices and the broader environment in which the team operates which are crucial to guide the team successfully.

You are expected to bring a strategic approach and guide the team to find opportunities to expand coverage, ensure quality and timeliness of the product, and improve processes closely with teams across data, product, and engineering.

We’ll Trust You To

 Recruit, mentor, and develop a team of data professionals who are experts in their field through processing time-sensitive, high-quality financial data, data analysis, and project management Collaborate globally with other data and core business groups, such as Product, Sales, News, and Engineering to help develop and improve fit-for-purpose data and functionality across the terminal Encourage the team to craft and implement proactive data quality management standard methodologies supported by customer-focused metrics and processes Develop data modeling and ETL skills within the team while collaborating with Engineering teams to develop a robust dataset that increases client’s value Build processes that enable the best methods of delivering data that surpasses client expectations using data governance expertise Stay up to date with industry trends and standard processes to be able to proactively spot opportunities for improvement

You’ll Need To Have

 Bachelor's degree, preferably in Economics, Finance, STEM, or related business field 3+ years of relevant leadership experience or strong relevant experience as an individual contributor as well as relevant domain knowledge Proven experience in a data management related role such as Data Quality, Data Modeling, and/or Data Engineering Proven experience with data analysis using tools such as Python, SQL, and/or Tableau Experience working with large datasets alongside the ability to quantify trends impacting the industry Ability to use qualitative and quantitative evidence to drive commercial decisions Strategic vision to align your team's goals while providing outstanding service to business and other internal/external clients Experience implementing a product strategy which delivers on that vision Superb interpersonal skills to establish strong credibility and influential relationships in order to communicate business needs and an operational strategy to internal and external partners Creative and flexible approach to problem solving, aided by strong data analysis skills

Does this sound like you?

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are.

Salary Range = 135,000 - 230,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

Description & Requirements

Who We Are / The Team

Bloomberg’s CTO Office is the future-looking technical and product arm of Bloomberg L.P. We envision, design, and prototype the next generation infrastructure, hardware, and applications for the Bloomberg Terminal. Our projects include machine learning-powered products, cloud computing infrastructure and strategy, open source stewardship, generative AI, and more. We are passionate about what we do.

At Bloomberg, we put our users first. The world is always changing, and so are the ways people interact with data. We need product leaders who thrive in dynamic environments - building products and platforms that power global financial markets and enable innovation across industries.

The Data Activation group, part of the Data & Analytics division in the Office of the CTO, is responsible for connecting Bloomberg’s data systems to customer outcomes, both internal and external. This pillar brings together data, artificial intelligence, APIs, and developer experience to ensure that Bloomberg’s vast data assets can be discovered, accessed, and activated seamlessly. Our remit spans integrations with the Bloomberg Terminal, first- and third-party API platforms, external developer ecosystems, AI/ML applications, and BQL (Bloomberg’s query language) that enables programmatic access to data.

About The Role

We’re seeking a Product Management Lead to head the Data Activation pillar — a senior leadership role within the Data & Analytics group, reporting into the CTO organization. This leader will manage a multidisciplinary team of product managers, data scientists, technical writers, and developer relations professionals focused on enabling data-driven innovation and empowering customers — both inside and outside Bloomberg — to build on top of our data.

You’ll define and execute a product strategy that connects Bloomberg’s internal data capabilities to real-world user experiences and outcomes. From shaping APIs and programmatic interfaces, to enabling AI and analytics use cases, to empowering external developers - you’ll drive the “last mile” of data activation across the company’s most strategic surfaces.

This is a unique opportunity to build and scale a product function that sits at the intersection of data, AI, and developer experience, influencing how Bloomberg delivers data intelligence to the world.

We’ll Trust You To

Define and deliver a compelling product vision and roadmap for how Bloomberg’s data is activated and experienced — across APIs, the Terminal, AI platforms, and developer ecosystems. Lead and mentor a high-performing team of product managers, developer advocates, and data-focused specialists — fostering a culture of customer obsession, technical excellence, and collaboration. Partner across engineering, AI research, and product teams to align on strategy and deliver seamless data access experiences that serve diverse user personas (developers, quants, analysts, researchers). Drive innovation in programmatic data access through BQL, APIs, SDKs, and integrations - enabling customers to embed Bloomberg data in their own workflows and applications, including emerging agentic AI use cases. Shape the external developer strategy, in partnership with engineering and business stakeholders, to extend the reach and impact of Bloomberg’s data platform through robust tools, documentation, and engagement programs. Define success metrics and KPIs, using data-driven insights to prioritize, measure adoption, and continuously improve the developer and data activation experience. Stay ahead of industry trends in data APIs, AI/ML integration, developer platforms, and data monetization to ensure Bloomberg remains at the forefront of data innovation. 

You’ll Need To Have

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.10+ years of experience in product management or related technical leadership roles, ideally within data, platform, or developer ecosystems. 5+ years of experience managing product teams and leading cross-disciplinary groups.Proven experience launching and scaling API or data platform products serving developers, analysts, or AI/ML practitioners. Strong understanding of data systems, APIs, and developer workflows, including knowledge of query languages and programmatic data access patterns. Exceptional ability to translate complex data and infrastructure capabilities into intuitive user-facing solutions. A track record of customer-centric product thinking and delivering outcomes that drive measurable impact. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align technical and business stakeholders around a shared vision. 

We’d Love To See

Master’s degree in a technical or business-related field.Experience building or scaling developer platforms or ecosystems.Familiarity with AI/ML tools, APIs, and applied data products.Background in data science, data engineering, or software development.Demonstrable knowledge of financial marketsDeep curiosity about how data, AI, and APIs combine to unlock new possibilities for customers and the broader developer community.

Salary Range = 235,000 - 350,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.

We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

Connect to your business - Technology and TransformationDistinctive thinking, deep expertise, innovation and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. rows.title: Data Scientist Associate - London (M,F,D) - Hybrid
rows.descriptionText:
About L.E.K. Consulting

L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.

How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us. Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognized as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.

The Team

L.E.K.’s Digital Data and AI team work alongside and support case teams in solving a range of digital and analytical problems, enabling L.E.K. to provide clients with the best possible advice.

The team’s collaborative approach is unique: our consulting teams leverage a high-powered self-service toolkit and domain expertise to build the analysis that underpins our commercial recommendations. As part of our team, you will be working alongside experienced project teams to develop cutting edge solutions to our clients’ toughest commercial problems.

The opportunity

As an Associate (Data Scientist) in L.E.K.’s Digital Data & AI team (DDA), you will help redefine how our case teams and clients leverage analytics and technology to solve their most complex challenges and transformations. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend L.E.K.’s hallmark analytical rigor with emerging Digital and AI capabilities to drive smarter, faster, and more scalable insights.

Day-to-day Responsibilities And Required Skills Include

Delivering fast-paced project modulesthat apply digital and data science techniques Supporting case teamsin selecting the appropriate data, digital and AI-enabled approaches, and helping them tie the insights to the commercial deliverableApplying knowledge of digital, data science and AI practices, including proper training, documentation, code collaboration, statistical significance, and governance of data and models Supporting the DDA team, contributing to data science capability building, internal training materials, awareness initiatives When not on project ideating, helping develop and deploying internal toolsInvesting in your own development, supported by strong senior sponsorship and dedicated time and resources to pursue personal growth goals 

What we are looking for

The Associate (Data Scienctist) role suits anyone with a passion to crack commercial and analytical problems and help enable others to do the same.

In addition to technical skills, we are looking for bright and driven people who want to deploy their knowledge and skills within high-impact commercial contexts and help others do the same.

You should have a sense of intellectual curiosity that inspires you to develop and generate innovative answers to complex questions.

We work together in teams, so we look for people who can collaborate and communicate well. We look for those who will make an impact by being proactive and taking ownership of their work with energy and enthusiasm.

We welcome applications from recent graduates and candidates with limited professional experience. Relevant academic, internship and independent project work all count.

Required

Understanding of structured problem-solving and analytical approaches Familiarity with data analysis and data exploration, ML techniques and statistical approaches Proficiency in Python, working knowledge of SQLUnderstanding of how digital and analytical methods support consulting work Ability to help turn an open-ended question into a structured analysis and explain the limitations of the findingsAbility to communicate analytical results to stakeholders with varied backgrounds and connect findings to a commercial question

Nice To Have

Knowledge of cloud environment like Azure, AWSFamiliarity with Git and software development practicesExperience with Generative AI, AI agentsExperience with model deployment

Reasons to join L.E.K.

Global firm spanning multiple sectors Opportunity to apply analytics to key commercial problems, usually working with C-suites, Private Equity, investment funds and boards Energetic, intelligent and enthusiastic colleagues Dedicated time and support for development through both a firm-wide Professional Development programme and a personalised development plan Automatic enrolment into valuable profit-sharing scheme Range of office and team social events and activities

rows.descriptionText:

The PEG Innovation team's mission is to create analytical solutions for Bain clients, teams, and the broader institutional investor space using proprietary software and data products. This includes the development, commercialization, and daily management of Bain's proprietary datasets, data, and software businesses.WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAMAI/ML Engineers on the Diligence Platform build and maintain the data, feature, and retrieval pipelines that power production RAG and ML systems. You work under the guidance of Senior ML Engineers and the Engineering Manager to implement and operate components of the ingestion, embedding, and retrieval stack, ship well-tested production code, and grow your ownership of these systems over time. You partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and the Agent / AI squad on defined pieces of larger pipelines and RAG workstreams, and you build the habits, tooling fluency, and production judgment expected of a Senior ML Engineer. This is a hands-on, growth-oriented engineering role: you are expected to ship reliable, observable code from your first weeks, and to take on increasing ownership as your track record builds.WHAT YOU'LL DOCore ML and Data Pipeline Engineering (65%) Implement and maintain components of production data and ML pipelines: ingestion jobs, feature and embedding pipelines, and Celery-based workers, under the direction of senior engineers.Build and support pieces of the RAG and retrieval stack: chunking, embedding calls, indexing into pgvector, and basic retrieval and re-ranking logic, following established patterns.Write production-quality Python: type hints, tests, and linting to the team's standards, with code reviewed by senior engineers before merge.Instrument the pipelines and services you own with structured logs and metrics, and help build the dashboards and alerts that make issues visible.Reproduce, triage, and fix bugs in pipeline and serving code, escalating ambiguous or high-severity issues to senior engineers.Collaboration and Support (25%)Partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and the Agent / AI squad on defined tasks within larger pipeline, retrieval, and evaluation workstreams.Contribute test cases and sample data to evaluation harnesses and golden datasets, under the direction of senior engineers.Participate in design reviews and code reviews, both as reviewer and reviewee, building judgment about production trade-offs.Keep runbooks, READMEs, and pipeline documentation current as you build and change the systems you touch.Other (10%):Use AI coding assistants to accelerate scaffolding and boilerplate, and review generated code against team standards before committing.Use LLMs to draft documentation and status notes; validate and refine outputs before sharing them.Take on interviewing and hiring-loop participation as your experience grows.ABOUT YOUBachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).2+ years of experience building software, data, or ML systems, ideally including some exposure to production pipelines or services.Exposure to model deployment, serving, or monitoring is a plus.Experience working with structured feedback and code review, and a track record of improving code quality over time.Experience collaborating with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, or the Agent / AI squad to ship features that depend on retrieval or ML outputs.Comfort with Python as a primary language; exposure to a modern cloud environment (Databricks, Azure, or AWS) is a plus.Demonstrated ability to take a well-scoped task from specification to a tested, reviewed implementation with limited supervision.
ML engineering / LLMOpsWorking knowledge of Python for data and ML workloads: type hints, Pydantic, pytest, Ruff, with production-quality pipeline and serving code that would pass a code review.Familiarity with MLflow concepts: experiment tracking, model registry, and promotion workflows.Exposure to LLMOps concepts: prompt versioning, model gateways (e.g., Portkey), and inference orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent).Good understanding of model-serving concepts: latency, throughput, and batching, even without direct production ownership yet.RAG pipeline building blocks: chunking strategies, embeddings, and vector stores such as pgvector; able to contribute to indexing and retrieval jobs under senior guidance.Understanding of model and pipeline evaluation basics: what a golden dataset is, and why regression gates matter in CI.Docker: comfortable containerising pipeline or serving code and running it locally for testing.Git: confident with PR-based workflows.Generative AI and agentic systemsContributes to inference and retrieval services that feed agent workflows as structured tool responses.Supports RAG quality work: helps build and run recall and precision checks against defined benchmarks.Exposure to LLM-as-judge evaluation patterns, even if applied under senior-engineer direction.GeneralTreats testing, observability, and documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought, even on smaller tasks.Raises questions and surfaces uncertainty early rather than guessing silently on ambiguous requirements.Uses AI tooling to move faster, and reviews all generated code and documentation critically before it enters the codebase.Communicates clearly with teammates about progress, blockers, and trade-offs; asks for help early.This role follows a hybrid model, requiring in-office presence at least 1 day per weekU.S. COMPENSATION INFORMATIONCompensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:In Atlanta, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $72,000 - $86,500In Texas, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $75,750 - $90,750In Chicago, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $79,500 - $95,250Placement within these ranges will vary based on factors such as experience, education, training, and skill level.Compensation also includes a discretionary annual performance bonus, 401(k) plan with employer contribution, and Bain’s best-in-class benefits—including full premium coverage for medical, dental, and vision, generous paid time off, and more.Annual discretionary performance bonus This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start dateBain & Company's comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family.Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheckGenerous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidaysFully vested 401(k) company contributionPaid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance

rows.title: AI/ML Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITHAs the premier consulting partner for the private equity industry, Bain's PEG boasts a global practice that is over three times larger than any competitor. Our network of over 1,000 professionals supports private equity and institutional investor clients through every stage of the investment life cycle, from deal generation and due diligence to portfolio value creation and exit planning.Bain & Company is developing a suite of cutting-edge data and software solutions designed to revolutionize how the private equity industry uses data for investment insights and decision-making. The PEG Innovation team's mission is to create analytical solutions for Bain clients, teams, and the broader institutional investor space using proprietary software and data products. This includes the development, commercialization, and daily management of Bain's proprietary datasets, data, and software businesses.WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAMAI/ML Engineers on the Diligence Platform build and maintain the data, feature, and retrieval pipelines that power production RAG and ML systems. You work under the guidance of Senior ML Engineers and the Engineering Manager to implement and operate components of the ingestion, embedding, and retrieval stack, ship well-tested production code, and grow your ownership of these systems over time. You partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and the Agent / AI squad on defined pieces of larger pipelines and RAG workstreams, and you build the habits, tooling fluency, and production judgment expected of a Senior ML Engineer. This is a hands-on, growth-oriented engineering role: you are expected to ship reliable, observable code from your first weeks, and to take on increasing ownership as your track record builds.WHAT YOU'LL DOCore ML and Data Pipeline Engineering (65%) Implement and maintain components of production data and ML pipelines: ingestion jobs, feature and embedding pipelines, and Celery-based workers, under the direction of senior engineers.Build and support pieces of the RAG and retrieval stack: chunking, embedding calls, indexing into pgvector, and basic retrieval and re-ranking logic, following established patterns.Write production-quality Python: type hints, tests, and linting to the team's standards, with code reviewed by senior engineers before merge.Instrument the pipelines and services you own with structured logs and metrics, and help build the dashboards and alerts that make issues visible.Reproduce, triage, and fix bugs in pipeline and serving code, escalating ambiguous or high-severity issues to senior engineers.Collaboration and Support (25%)Partner with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and the Agent / AI squad on defined tasks within larger pipeline, retrieval, and evaluation workstreams.Contribute test cases and sample data to evaluation harnesses and golden datasets, under the direction of senior engineers.Participate in design reviews and code reviews, both as reviewer and reviewee, building judgment about production trade-offs.Keep runbooks, READMEs, and pipeline documentation current as you build and change the systems you touch.Other (10%):Use AI coding assistants to accelerate scaffolding and boilerplate, and review generated code against team standards before committing.Use LLMs to draft documentation and status notes; validate and refine outputs before sharing them.Take on interviewing and hiring-loop participation as your experience grows.ABOUT YOUBachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).2+ years of experience building software, data, or ML systems, ideally including some exposure to production pipelines or services.Exposure to model deployment, serving, or monitoring is a plus.Experience working with structured feedback and code review, and a track record of improving code quality over time.Experience collaborating with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, or the Agent / AI squad to ship features that depend on retrieval or ML outputs.Comfort with Python as a primary language; exposure to a modern cloud environment (Databricks, Azure, or AWS) is a plus.Demonstrated ability to take a well-scoped task from specification to a tested, reviewed implementation with limited supervision.
ML engineering / LLMOpsWorking knowledge of Python for data and ML workloads: type hints, Pydantic, pytest, Ruff, with production-quality pipeline and serving code that would pass a code review.Familiarity with MLflow concepts: experiment tracking, model registry, and promotion workflows.Exposure to LLMOps concepts: prompt versioning, model gateways (e.g., Portkey), and inference orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent).Good understanding of model-serving concepts: latency, throughput, and batching, even without direct production ownership yet.RAG pipeline building blocks: chunking strategies, embeddings, and vector stores such as pgvector; able to contribute to indexing and retrieval jobs under senior guidance.Understanding of model and pipeline evaluation basics: what a golden dataset is, and why regression gates matter in CI.Docker: comfortable containerising pipeline or serving code and running it locally for testing.Git: confident with PR-based workflows.Generative AI and agentic systemsContributes to inference and retrieval services that feed agent workflows as structured tool responses.Supports RAG quality work: helps build and run recall and precision checks against defined benchmarks.Exposure to LLM-as-judge evaluation patterns, even if applied under senior-engineer direction.GeneralTreats testing, observability, and documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought, even on smaller tasks.Raises questions and surfaces uncertainty early rather than guessing silently on ambiguous requirements.Uses AI tooling to move faster, and reviews all generated code and documentation critically before it enters the codebase.Communicates clearly with teammates about progress, blockers, and trade-offs; asks for help early.This role follows a hybrid model, requiring in-office presence at least 1 day per weekU.S. COMPENSATION INFORMATIONCompensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:In Atlanta, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $72,000 - $86,500In Texas, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $75,750 - $90,750In Chicago, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $79,500 - $95,250Placement within these ranges will vary based on factors such as experience, education, training, and skill level.Compensation also includes a discretionary annual performance bonus, 401(k) plan with employer contribution, and Bain’s best-in-class benefits—including full premium coverage for medical, dental, and vision, generous paid time off, and more.Annual discretionary performance bonus This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start dateBain & Company's comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family.Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheckGenerous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidaysFully vested 401(k) company contributionPaid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance
